  }

 updateHud(now){if(!battle?.active)return;const p=current(),e=foe();for(const [who,m] of [['ally',p],['enemy',e]]){let bar=$(who+'HP'),label=$(who+'HpText');if(bar)bar.style.width=clamp(m.hp/m.maxHp*100,0,100)+'%';if(label)label.textContent=`${Math.ceil(m.hp)}/${m.maxHp} PV`;if(bar)bar.style.background=m.hp/m.maxHp<.24?'linear-gradient(90deg,#f2655f,#ffb46a)':'linear-gradient(90deg,#2de6a1,#b0ffb7)'}const en=$('energyNumber'),fill=$('energyFill'),g=$('guardStatus'),d=$('dodgeBtn');if(en)en.textContent=Math.round(battle.energy);if(fill)fill.style.width=battle.energy+'%';if(g)g.textContent=this.player.guard>0?'🛡 ESCUDO ATIVO':(this.aim.x!==null&&now<this.aim.until?'MIRA MANUAL':'MIRA AUTOMÁTICA');if(d){d.disabled=this.player.dodgeCd>0||battle.energy<12;d.querySelector('small').textContent=this.player.dodgeCd>0?this.player.dodgeCd.toFixed(1)+' s':'ESQUIVA'}const fps=$('fpsChip');if(fps)fps.textContent=`${this.fps} FPS · medidos`;let ss=skillSet(p);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let b=document.querySelector(`[data-skill="${i}"]`),mask=$('coolMask'+i),ct=$('coolText'+i);if(!b||!mask||!ct)continue;let remain=Math.max(0,cooldowns[i]-now),pct=Math.min(100,remain/ss[i].cd*100);b.disabled=battle.energy<ss[i].cost||remain>0||battle.paused;mask.style.height=pct+'%';ct.textContent=remain>0?(remain/1000).toFixed(1)+'s':'';}}

function awardXP(m,amount){let events=[];m.xp+=amount;let cap=GYMS[Math.min(12,save.gym)].levelCap;while(m.level<cap && m.xp>=xpNeed(m.level)){m.xp-=xpNeed(m.level);m.level++;let oldMax=m.maxHp,info=D[m.id];m.maxHp=Math.round(info.hp*2*m.level/100+m.level+16);m.hp+=m.maxHp-oldMax;if(info.evolve&&m.level>=info.at){let before=info.name;m.id=info.evolve;info=D[m.id];m.maxHp=Math.round(info.hp*2*m.level/100+m.level+16);m.hp=m.maxHp;events.push(before+' → '+info.name)}else events.push(info.name+' Nv. '+m.level)}return events}

// V10: geometria e busca A* adaptadas de conceitos documentados no Emerald Arena;
// esta implementacao JavaScript e independente do codigo C do GBA.
BattleEngine.prototype.clearPath=function(ax,ay,bx,by,extra=0){
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,len=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 for(const r of this.rocks){if(r.hp<=0)continue;
  const rr=r.radius+this.h*.061+extra;
  const t=len?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((r.x-ax)*dx+(r.y-ay)*dy)/len)):0;
  const cx=ax+t*dx,cy=ay+t*dy;
  if((cx-r.x)**2+(cy-r.y)**2<rr*rr)return false;
 }
 return true;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.findWaypoint=function(from,to){
 if(this.clearPath(from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y))return {x:to.x,y:to.y};
 const gap=this.h*.09,vertices=[];
 for(const r of this.rocks){if(r.hp<=0)continue;const rr=r.radius+this.h*.061+gap;
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const angle=Math.PI*2*i/8;
   let x=r.x+Math.cos(angle)*rr,y=r.y+Math.sin(angle)*rr;
   if(x>this.w*.068&&x<this.w*.932&&y>this.h*.245&&y<this.h*.83&&this.clearPath(x,y,x,y))vertices.push({x,y});
  }
 }
 const n=vertices.length,pts=[{x:from.x,y:from.y},...vertices,{x:to.x,y:to.y}],dest=n+1;
 const g=new Array(n+2).fill(Infinity),f=new Array(n+2).fill(Infinity),prev=new Array(n+2).fill(-1),closed=new Set();
 const heuristic=i=>Math.hypot(pts[i].x-to.x,pts[i].y-to.y);
 g[0]=0;f[0]=heuristic(0);
 for(let attempt=0;attempt<pts.length;attempt++){
  let best=-1;
  for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++)if(!closed.has(i)&&(best<0||f[i]<f[best]))best=i;
  if(best<0||!Number.isFinite(f[best]))break;
  if(best===dest){let at=dest;while(prev[at]>0)at=prev[at];return pts[at]}
  closed.add(best);
  for(let j=1;j<pts.length;j++){if(closed.has(j)||j===best)continue;
   if(!this.clearPath(pts[best].x,pts[best].y,pts[j].x,pts[j].y))continue;
   const alt=g[best]+Math.hypot(pts[best].x-pts[j].x,pts[best].y-pts[j].y);
   if(alt<g[j]){g[j]=alt;prev[j]=best;f[j]=alt+heuristic(j)}
  }
 }
 return {x:to.x,y:to.y};
};
BattleEngine.prototype.nextAiGoal=function(e,p){
 if(!this.aiReplan||this.time>this.aiReplan){this.aiGoal=this.findWaypoint(e,p);this.aiReplan=this.time+.25;}
 return this.aiGoal||p;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.segmentTouches=function(a,b,x,y,radius){
 let dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,l=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 let t=l?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a.x)*dx+(y-a.y)*dy)/l)):0;
 return Math.hypot(a.x+dx*t-x,a.y+dy*t-y)<=radius;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.elementalBurst=function(x,y,type,scale=1){
 const c=TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#f8e5af';
 const n=Math.min(52,Math.round(19*scale));this.particlesAt(x,y,c,n,120*scale);
 const wave=type==='water'?'#92f1ff':type==='fire'?'#ffe0a0':type==='electric'?'#ffff8c':'#ffffff';
 this.rings.push({x,y,r:6,life:.40,color:wave});
 if(type==='fire')for(let i=0;i<12;i++)this.particles.push({x:x+rnd(-12,12),y:y+rnd(-12,12),vx:rnd(-75,75),vy:rnd(-220,-60),life:rnd(.28,.67),max:.7,color:'#ffa43d',r:rnd(2,5)});
 if(type==='water')for(let i=0;i<10;i++)this.particles.push({x,y,vx:rnd(-140,140),vy:rnd(-160,-50),life:rnd(.3,.8),max:.8,color:'#b5f8ff',r:rnd(2,5)});
 if(type==='electric')for(let i=0;i<4;i++)this.rings.push({x:x+rnd(-18,18),y:y+rnd(-18,18),r:3,life:.2,color:'#fff68f'});
};
const originalV10Hit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 const target=who==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 if(target.inv>0)return originalV10Hit.call(this,who,type,power);
 this.elementalBurst(target.x,target.y,type,1.15);

const originalV10Dodge=BattleEngine.prototype.dodge;

  for(let i=1;i<=4;i++){const t=i/5;
   this.particlesAt(old.x+(this.player.x-old.x)*t,old.y+(this.player.y-old.y)*t,'#7deef8',5,60);
  }

};

window.__V351_OLD_STATUS=V25_STATUS;
const v25OldSkillSet=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){const moves=v25OldSkillSet(m);moves[3]={...moves[3],kind:'status',cat:'status',name:moves[3].name==='Proteção Aquática'?'Withdraw':moves[3].name};return moves};
const v25OldSkillMarkup=skillMarkup;
skillMarkup=function(s,i){let html=v25OldSkillMarkup(s,i);if(i===3&&V25_STATUS[s.name])html=html.replace('Status</small>',`Status · ${V25_STATUS[s.name].mode==='buff'?'Bônus':V25_STATUS[s.name].mode==='debuff'?'Redução':V25_STATUS[s.name].mode==='condition'?'Condição':'Purificação'}</small>`);return html};

function v25Stats(){return {atk:1,def:1,speed:1,accuracy:1,conditions:[],ticker:0}}
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize=function(){
  this.v25={stats:{player:v25Stats(),enemy:v25Stats()},entry:[],capture:null,impactMessage:[],stage:save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)};
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Popup=function(x,y,text,color='#ffecb7'){
  this.v25?.impactMessage.push({x,y,life:.90,max:.90,text,color});
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25PlayEntry=function(side){
  if(!this.v25)return;
  let a=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
  const fromX=side==='enemy'?this.w+24:-24;
  this.v25.entry.push({side,phase:0,time:0,duration:.95,fromX,fromY:this.h*.22,toX:a.x,toY:a.y-this.h*.15});
  battle.paused=true;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Ball=function(c,x,y,r,rotation=0){
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(rotation);c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.14);c.strokeStyle='#142336';c.shadowColor='#0008';c.shadowBlur=4;
  c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.clip();
  c.fillStyle='#e6edf4';c.fillRect(-r,-r,r*2,r*2);
  const grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,-r,0,0);grad.addColorStop(0,'#ff9b87');grad.addColorStop(.45,'#e2474b');grad.addColorStop(1,'#c72c3e');c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(-r,-r,r*2,r);
  c.fillStyle='#172436';c.fillRect(-r,-r*.13,r*2,r*.26);
  c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.35,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle='#eff9ff';c.fill();c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,r*.16);c.strokeStyle='#172436';c.stroke();
  c.restore();c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(rotation);c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.lineWidth=1.7;c.strokeStyle='#0e1a27';c.stroke();c.restore();
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Update=function(dt){
  const v=this.v25;if(!v||!battle?.active)return;
  for(const entry of v.entry){entry.time+=dt;const t=Math.min(1,entry.time/entry.duration);if(!entry.spark && t>=.64){entry.spark=true;const col=entry.side==='enemy'?'#8ed4ff':'#ffda90';this.particlesAt(entry.toX,entry.toY,col,v.stage?31:19,95);this.rings.push({x:entry.toX,y:entry.toY,r:7,life:.38,color:col});playSound('select')}}
  const hadEntry=v.entry.length>0;
  v.entry=v.entry.filter(e=>e.time<e.duration);
  if(v.capture){let k=v.capture;k.time+=dt;
    if(!k.spark && k.time>=.48){k.spark=true;this.particlesAt(k.toX,k.toY,'#ffde9b',20,100);this.rings.push({x:k.toX,y:k.toY,r:6,life:.38,color:'#ffe3a0'})}
    if(!k.shake && k.time>=.90){k.shake=true;playSound('select')}
    if(k.time>=k.duration){v.capture=null;const m=foe();if(k.success){const caught=mon(m.id,m.level);caught.shiny=!!m.shiny;if(save.team.length<6)save.team.push(caught);else save.box.push(caught);if(caught.id<=151&&!save.caught.includes(caught.id))save.caught.push(caught.id);if(!save.seen.includes(caught.id))save.seen.push(caught.id);log(`${D[m.id].name} capturado!`);playSound('catch');persist();finishCapture(m)}else{log(`${D[m.id].name} escapou da Pokébola!`);this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#ff6b78',24,130);this.enemy.inv=.40;playSound('miss');battle.paused=false;persist()}}
  }
  for(const msg of v.impactMessage){msg.life-=dt;msg.y-=dt*25}
  v.impactMessage=v.impactMessage.filter(m=>m.life>0);
  if(hadEntry && !v.entry.length && !v.capture && battle.paused)battle.paused=false;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Draw=function(c){
  const v=this.v25;if(!v)return;
  for(const e of v.entry){const t=Math.min(1,e.time/e.duration),r=this.h*.022,x=e.fromX+(e.toX-e.fromX)*Math.min(1,t/.64),y=e.fromY+(e.toY-e.fromY)*Math.min(1,t/.64)-Math.sin(Math.min(1,t/.64)*Math.PI)*this.h*.13;
    if(t<.64){c.save();c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.20)';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(e.fromX,e.fromY);c.quadraticCurveTo((e.fromX+e.toX)/2,Math.min(e.fromY,e.toY)-this.h*.18,x,y);c.stroke();c.restore();this.v25Ball(c,x,y,r,t*11)}
    else{let p=(t-.64)/.36;c.save();c.globalAlpha=(1-p)*.75;c.strokeStyle=e.side==='enemy'?'#a6eaff':'#ffe0a1';c.shadowColor=c.strokeStyle;c.shadowBlur=11;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){c.lineWidth=2-j*.35;c.beginPath();c.arc(e.toX,e.toY,8+p*18+j*8,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke()}c.restore()}
  }
  if(v.capture){const k=v.capture,t=k.time,cx=k.toX,cy=k.toY,rad=this.h*.024;
    if(t<.48){const f=t/.48,x=k.fromX+(cx-k.fromX)*f,y=k.fromY+(cy-k.fromY)*f-Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*this.h*.2;this.v25Ball(c,x,y,rad,f*13)}
    else if(t<1.40){const shake=t>.88?Math.sin((t-.88)*31)*Math.min(1,(t-.88)*2)*.27:0;this.v25Ball(c,cx,cy+this.h*.035,rad,shake);
      c.save();c.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,235,172,${.4+.4*Math.cos(t*12)})`;c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy+this.h*.035,rad*1.36,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();
    }else{let f=Math.min(1,(t-1.40)/.26);c.save();c.globalAlpha=1-f;c.strokeStyle=k.success?'#ffe785':'#ff7777';c.shadowColor=c.strokeStyle;c.shadowBlur=12;c.lineWidth=2;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy,8+f*32+j*11,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke()}c.restore()}
  }
  for(const msg of v.impactMessage){c.save();c.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,msg.life*2);c.textAlign='center';c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeStyle='#081522';c.font=`900 ${Math.max(11,this.h*.031)}px system-ui`;c.strokeText(msg.text,msg.x,msg.y);c.fillStyle=msg.color;c.fillText(msg.text,msg.x,msg.y);c.restore()}
};

const v25OldDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,enemy,now){
 const v=this.v25,side=enemy?'enemy':'player',entry=v?.entry.find(e=>e.side===side);
 if(entry && entry.time/entry.duration<.64)return;
 if(enemy&&v?.capture?.time>=.48)return;
 return v25OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,enemy,now);
};
const v25OldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){v25OldDraw.call(this,now);this.v25Draw(this.ctx)};
const v25OldStart=BattleEngine.prototype.start;
BattleEngine.prototype.start=function(){this.v25Initialize();let r=v25OldStart.call(this);this.v25PlayEntry('player');this.v25PlayEntry('enemy');return r};
BattleEngine.prototype.frame=function(now){if(!this.running||!battle?.active)return;let dt=Math.min(.040,(now-this.last)/1000||.016);this.last=now;
 if(!battle.paused)this.update(dt,now);
 this.v25Update(dt);
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 this.draw(now);
 if(now-this.lastHud>80){this.updateHud(now);this.lastHud=now}
 this.frames++;if(now-this.frameStart>1000){this.fps=Math.round(this.frames*1000/(now-this.frameStart));this.frames=0;this.frameStart=now}
 this.raf=requestAnimationFrame(t=>this.frame(t));
};
const v25OldSwitchMon=BattleEngine.prototype.switchMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.switchMon=function(){let r=v25OldSwitchMon.call(this);if(this.v25){this.v25.stats.player=v25Stats();this.v25PlayEntry('player')}return r};
const v25OldNewEnemy=BattleEngine.prototype.newEnemy;
BattleEngine.prototype.newEnemy=function(){let r=v25OldNewEnemy.call(this);document.querySelector('.hudPro.enemy .v25EffectChip')?.remove();if(this.v25){this.v25.stats.enemy=v25Stats();this.v25PlayEntry('enemy')}return r};


function v25MoveSound(type){
 if(!soundEnabled)return;
 try{
  audioCtx=audioCtx||new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  const now=audioCtx.currentTime, voice=audioCtx.createOscillator(), gain=audioCtx.createGain();
  const shapes={fire:['sawtooth',270,720,.19],water:['sine',480,190,.23],electric:['square',950,430,.13],psychic:['sine',390,620,.26],ghost:['triangle',330,140,.29],grass:['triangle',360,550,.20],flying:['sine',650,420,.16],rock:['triangle',150,65,.18]};
  const [wave,start,end,length]=shapes[type]||['triangle',360,520,.14];
  voice.type=wave;voice.frequency.setValueAtTime(start,now);voice.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(55,end),now+length);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.034,now);gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+length);
  voice.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);voice.start(now);voice.stop(now+length);
 }catch{}
}
function v25StatusChip(where,info){
 const box=document.querySelector(`.hudPro.${where}`);if(!box)return;
 let el=box.querySelector('.v25EffectChip');if(!el){el=document.createElement('span');el.className='v25EffectChip';box.appendChild(el)}
 el.textContent=info;el.classList.remove('v25EffectPulse');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('v25EffectPulse');
}
BattleEngine.prototype.v25ApplyStatus=function(s){
 const info=V25_STATUS[s.name];if(!info)return false;
 const v=this.v25,own=v.stats.player,foeStat=v.stats.enemy,target=info.mode==='buff'?own:foeStat;
 if(info.mode==='reset') {for(const side of ['player','enemy']){let st=v.stats[side];st.atk=st.def=st.speed=st.accuracy=1} }
 else if(info.mode==='condition'){if(!foeStat.conditions.includes(info.effect))foeStat.conditions.push(info.effect);foeStat.ticker=0}
 else{
  let delta=info.amount*(info.mode==='buff'?1:-1);
  let keys=info.stat==='atkdef'?['atk','def']:info.stat==='atkspeed'?['atk','speed']:[info.stat];
  for(const key of keys)target[key]=Math.min(1.85,Math.max(.48,target[key]+delta));
 }
 const victim=info.mode==='buff'||info.mode==='reset'?this.player:this.enemy,col=TYPE_COLOR[s.type]||'#fbe1ae';
 this.particlesAt(victim.x,victim.y-this.h*.10,col,18,100);
 this.rings.push({x:victim.x,y:victim.y,r:7,life:.40,color:col});
 this.v25Popup(victim.x,victim.y-this.h*.29,info.label,info.mode==='debuff'||info.mode==='condition'?'#ffdaaa':'#b9ffde');
 v25StatusChip(info.mode==='buff'||info.mode==='reset'?'ally':'enemy',info.label);v25MoveSound(s.type);
 log(`${D[current().id].name} usou ${s.name}! ${info.detail}.`);playSound('heal');return true;
};
const v25OldUseMove=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 if(i!==3){const move=skillSet(current())[i];const energy=battle?.energy||0;const r=v25OldUseMove.call(this,i);if(battle?.active&&energy>battle.energy)v25MoveSound(move.type);return r;}
 if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||current().hp<=0)return;
 const s=skillSet(current())[i],now=performance.now();if(cooldowns[i]>now||battle.energy<s.cost)return;
 battle.energy-=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=now+s.cd;this.attackActs.player=this.time+.37;
 if(!this.v25ApplyStatus(s)){log(`${s.name} não possui efeito configurado.`);battle.energy+=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=0}
};
const v25OldHitTarget=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 const v=this.v25;if(!v)return v25OldHitTarget.call(this,who,type,power);
 const attack=who==='enemy'?v.stats.player:v.stats.enemy,defense=who==='enemy'?v.stats.enemy:v.stats.player;
 // Accuracy penalty from Smokescreen/Sand Attack
 if(Math.random()>attack.accuracy){this.v25Popup(who==='enemy'?this.player.x:this.enemy.x,who==='enemy'?this.player.y:this.enemy.y,'ERROU','#dce6f5');playSound('miss');return}
 const calculated=power*attack.atk/Math.max(.5,defense.def);
 const victim=who==='enemy'?foe():current();
 const before=victim.hp;
 let r=v25OldHitTarget.call(this,who,type,calculated);
 const damaged=before-victim.hp;
 /* V26 critical hits are calculated and displayed only when damage is actually applied. */
 return r;
};
// Status effects tick while battle is active; paralyzed enemies skip some attacks.
const v25OldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const status=this.v25?.stats.enemy;
 if(status?.conditions.includes('paralysis'))this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*.7;
 if(status?.conditions.includes('confusion'))this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*.6;
 if(status?.speed<1)this.enemyAttackCD+=dt*(1-status.speed);
 v25OldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.v25)return;
 const enemy=this.v25.stats.enemy;
 if(enemy.conditions.includes('poison')){enemy.ticker+=dt;if(enemy.ticker>=3.2){enemy.ticker=0;const m=foe(),dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(m.maxHp*.035));m.hp=Math.max(1,m.hp-dmg);this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.30,`VENENO -${dmg}`,'#d8a7ff');this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#bd8bdf',11,72)}}
};

const v25OldCatchMon=catchMon;
catchMon=function(){
 if(!battle?.active||!battle.wild||!save.balls||battle.paused||!engine?.v25)return;
 save.balls--;persist();const n=$('ballCount');if(n)n.textContent=save.balls;
 const m=foe(),chance=.17+.72*(1-m.hp/m.maxHp),success=Math.random()<chance;
 engine.v25.capture={time:0,duration:1.65,fromX:engine.player.x,fromY:engine.player.y-engine.h*.16,toX:engine.enemy.x,toY:engine.enemy.y-engine.h*.15,success,spark:false,shake:false};
 battle.paused=true;log(`Pokébola lançada em ${D[m.id].name}!`);playSound('dash');
};

const v25OldRenderBattle=renderBattle;
renderBattle=function(){v25OldRenderBattle();const heading=document.querySelector('.battleHeading h2');if(heading&&save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)&&!battle.wild){heading.innerHTML=`<span class="v25BossIcon">👑</span> ${heading.textContent}`;heading.classList.add('v25BossHeading')}const footer=document.querySelector('.energyHud');if(footer&&!document.getElementById('v25Coin')){const chip=document.createElement('span');chip.id='v25Coin';chip.className='v25Coin';chip.textContent=`🪙 ${save.coins} moedas`;footer.appendChild(chip)} };


/* V26 — feedback de combate fundamentado no cálculo de dano e atributos;
 * partículas autorais leves desenhadas no mesmo Canvas 2D, sem dependências externas. */
const V26_INFO={
 fire:{name:'chama',glyph:'ember'},water:{name:'água',glyph:'bubble'},electric:{name:'raio',glyph:'bolt'},
 grass:{name:'folha',glyph:'leaf'},psychic:{name:'psíquico',glyph:'star'},ghost:{name:'espectro',glyph:'orbit'},
 poison:{name:'veneno',glyph:'orbit'},ice:{name:'gelo',glyph:'star'},flying:{name:'vento',glyph:'feather'},
 dragon:{name:'dragão',glyph:'star'},rock:{name:'pedra',glyph:'rock'},ground:{name:'terra',glyph:'rock'},
 bug:{name:'inseto',glyph:'leaf'},steel:{name:'metal',glyph:'star'},fairy:{name:'fada',glyph:'star'},
 fighting:{name:'luta',glyph:'slash'},dark:{name:'trevas',glyph:'orbit'},normal:{name:'normal',glyph:'slash'}
};
const V26_SIGNATURES={
  1:{label:'Chicote de Vinha',glyph:'leaf',color:'#b2ff8d',extra:2},
  3:{label:'Jardim Solar',glyph:'leaf',color:'#a7ef6a',extra:8},
  4:{label:'Brasa Viva',glyph:'ember',color:'#ffb45e',extra:3},
  5:{label:'Chama Ardente',glyph:'ember',color:'#ff914b',extra:5},
  6:{label:'Fogo de Dragão',glyph:'ember',color:'#ff7445',extra:10},
  7:{label:'Jato Borbulhante',glyph:'bubble',color:'#8de7ff',extra:3},
  9:{label:'Canhão d’Água',glyph:'bubble',color:'#78e7ff',extra:9},
  25:{label:'Descarga de Pikachu',glyph:'bolt',color:'#ffe26a',extra:7},
  26:{label:'Tempestade Elétrica',glyph:'bolt',color:'#fff1a0',extra:10},
  94:{label:'Névoa Sombria',glyph:'orbit',color:'#c79dff',extra:9},
  95:{label:'Impacto de Pedra',glyph:'rock',color:'#d9c7a1',extra:8},
  131:{label:'Maré Glacial',glyph:'star',color:'#b8efff',extra:7},
  149:{label:'Pulsação Dracônica',glyph:'star',color:'#c9a1ff',extra:10},
  150:{label:'Poder Psíquico',glyph:'orbit',color:'#f1a3ff',extra:11},
  151:{label:'Luz de Mew',glyph:'star',color:'#ffcce9',extra:10}
};
const V26_STAT_NAMES={atk:'ATK',def:'DEF',speed:'VEL',accuracy:'PREC'};
const v26Fmt=x=>Number(x).toFixed(2).replace('.',',');

BattleEngine.prototype.v26Init=function(){
 this.v26Labels=[];this.v26Particles=[];
 this.v26Combo={hits:0,last:-99};
 this.v26PendingEnemy=null;
 this.v26LastStatusMove=null;
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26Label=function(side,message,color='#edfcff',category='notice'){
 if(!this.v26Labels)this.v26Init();
 const actor=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 // Limit simultaneous labels, prioritizing newest messages. This is safe on narrow mobile canvases.
 const count=this.v26Labels.filter(o=>o.side===side).length;
 const text=String(message).slice(0,37);
 const anchorX=actor.x+(side==='enemy'?-this.h*.090:this.h*.090);
 const x=clamp(anchorX,66,this.w-66);
 const y=clamp(actor.y-this.h*.14-Math.min(count,3)*15,this.h*.19,this.h*.81);
 this.v26Labels.push({side,text,x,y,life:1.23,max:1.23,color,category});
 if(this.v26Labels.length>16)this.v26Labels.splice(0,this.v26Labels.length-16);
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26CastFx=function(side,type,monId,ultimate=false){
 if(!this.v26Particles)this.v26Init();
 const a=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 const sig=V26_SIGNATURES[monId];
 const base=V26_INFO[type]||V26_INFO.normal;
 const glyph=(sig && (D[monId].type===type||D[monId].type2===type))?sig.glyph:base.glyph;
 const color=sig?.color||TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#e9faff';
 const max=ultimate?20:12;
 const n=Math.min(30,max+(sig?.extra||0));
 const ax=a.x,ay=a.y-this.h*.14;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
   const angle=(i/n)*Math.PI*2+(Math.random()-.5)*.45;
   const distance=5+Math.random()*this.h*.035;
   const speed=18+Math.random()*(ultimate?82:55);
   const life=.25+Math.random()*.35;
   this.v26Particles.push({x:ax+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:ay+Math.sin(angle)*distance,
     vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed-this.h*.018,life,max:life,color,
     glyph,r:1.5+Math.random()*(ultimate?3.4:2.3),rot:Math.random()*6.28});
 }
 if(this.v26Particles.length>110)this.v26Particles.splice(0,this.v26Particles.length-110);
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26ImpactFx=function(side,type,monId,critical=false){
 if(!this.v26Particles)this.v26Init();
 const a=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 const glyph=(V26_SIGNATURES[monId]?.glyph)||(V26_INFO[type]?.glyph)||'star';
 const color=TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#fff3ae';
 const n=critical?18:10;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
  const angle=i*Math.PI*2/n+Math.random()*.2,speed=21+Math.random()*70,life=.20+Math.random()*.36;
  this.v26Particles.push({x:a.x,y:a.y-this.h*.19,vx:Math.cos(angle)*speed,vy:Math.sin(angle)*speed,
   life,max:life,glyph,color,r:1.8+Math.random()*2.3,rot:angle});
 }
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26Update=function(dt){
 if(!this.v26Labels)this.v26Init();
 for(const a of this.v26Labels){a.life-=dt;a.y-=dt*15}
 this.v26Labels=this.v26Labels.filter(a=>a.life>0);
 for(const p of this.v26Particles){p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vx*=.985;p.vy*=.985}
 this.v26Particles=this.v26Particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26DrawFx=function(c){
 if(!this.v26Particles)return;
 c.save();
 for(const p of this.v26Particles){
  const alpha=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);c.save();c.translate(p.x,p.y);c.rotate(p.rot);
  c.globalAlpha=alpha*.88;c.strokeStyle=p.color;c.fillStyle=p.color;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,p.r*.38);
  const r=p.r;
  if(p.glyph==='bolt'){
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,-r);c.lineTo(r*.05,-r*.15);c.lineTo(-r*.20,r*.3);c.lineTo(r*.85,r);c.stroke();
  }else if(p.glyph==='bubble'){
    c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#ffffffbd';c.beginPath();c.arc(-r*.28,-r*.3,Math.max(.5,r*.19),0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  }else if(p.glyph==='leaf'||p.glyph==='feather'){
    c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,r*1.34,r*.50,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
    c.strokeStyle='#e4ffd8b0';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,0);c.lineTo(r*.8,0);c.stroke();
  }else if(p.glyph==='star'){
    c.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<8;i++){let a=i*Math.PI/4,rr=i%2?r*.36:r*1.5;
    let x=Math.cos(a)*rr,y=Math.sin(a)*rr;i?c.lineTo(x,y):c.moveTo(x,y)}c.closePath();c.fill();
  }else if(p.glyph==='orbit'){
    c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r,0,7);c.stroke();c.beginPath();c.arc(r*.7,r*.1,r*.25,0,7);c.fill();
  }else if(p.glyph==='rock'){
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,-r*.2);c.lineTo(-r*.3,-r);c.lineTo(r*.7,-r*.5);c.lineTo(r,r*.5);c.lineTo(-r*.4,r);c.closePath();c.fill();
  }else if(p.glyph==='slash'){
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*1.3,r*.8);c.lineTo(r*1.3,-r*.8);c.stroke();
  }else{ // ember
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-r*1.6);c.quadraticCurveTo(r*1.6,0,r*.45,r);
    c.quadraticCurveTo(-r*.8,r*1.7,-r*.75,.1);c.closePath();c.fill();
  }
  c.restore();
 }
 c.restore();
};
BattleEngine.prototype.v26DrawLabels=function(c){
 if(!this.v26Labels)return;
 c.save();
 for(const a of this.v26Labels){
  const t=Math.min(1,a.life/.20);c.save();c.globalAlpha=t;
  const sz=clamp(this.h*.026,9,12),padX=7;
  c.font=`850 ${sz}px system-ui`;c.textBaseline='middle';c.textAlign='left';
  const ww=Math.min(this.w*.65,c.measureText(a.text).width+padX*2), hh=sz+9;
  const x=clamp(a.x-ww*.5,3,this.w-ww-3),y=clamp(a.y-hh*.5,7,this.h-hh-8);
  c.fillStyle='rgba(9,24,37,.86)';c.strokeStyle=a.color;c.lineWidth=1;
  c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,ww,hh,6);c.fill();c.globalAlpha*=.53;c.stroke();c.globalAlpha=t;
  c.fillStyle=a.color;c.fillText(a.text,x+padX,y+hh*.5+.4);
  c.restore();
 }
 c.restore();
};
// Reuse existing canvas callbacks; no second rendering loop or extra library required.
const v26OldInit=BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize;
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize=function(){v26OldInit.call(this);this.v26Init()};
const v26OldUpdateFx=BattleEngine.prototype.v25Update;
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Update=function(dt){v26OldUpdateFx.call(this,dt);this.v26Update(dt)};
const v26OldDrawFx=BattleEngine.prototype.v25Draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Draw=function(c){v26OldDrawFx.call(this,c);this.v26DrawFx(c);this.v26DrawLabels(c)};

// Signature moves adapted for some iconic Kanto species, in addition to unique particles.
// They preserve the four existing action slots, with balanced energy/cooldown values.
const V26_MOVESETS={
 1:{1:{name:'Chicote de Vinha',power:31,cat:'physical',icon:'🍃'}},
 3:{1:{name:'Folha Navalha',power:34},2:{name:'Raio Solar',power:56,icon:'☀️'}},
 4:{1:{name:'Brasa Viva',power:30,icon:'🔥'}},
 5:{1:{name:'Chama Ardente',power:33,icon:'🔥'}},
 6:{1:{name:'Lança-Chamas',power:34,icon:'🔥'},2:{name:'Blast Burn',power:57,icon:'🐉'}},
 7:{1:{name:'Bolhas',power:29,icon:'🫧'}},
 9:{1:{name:'Cauda de Água',power:34,cat:'physical',icon:'💧'},2:{name:'Hidro Canhão',power:57,icon:'🌊'}},
 22:{1:{name:'Drill Peck',power:33,cat:'physical',type:'flying',icon:'🪶'}},
 25:{1:{name:'Faísca do Pikachu',power:32,icon:'⚡'},2:{name:'Thunderbolt',power:53,icon:'🌩️'}},
 26:{1:{name:'Descarga Elétrica',power:34,icon:'⚡'}},
 38:{1:{name:'Roda de Fogo',power:33,icon:'🔥'}},
 94:{1:{name:'Sombra Noturna',power:33,type:'ghost',icon:'👻'},2:{name:'Shadow Ball',power:55,type:'ghost',icon:'🌑'}},
 95:{1:{name:'Rock Tomb',power:33,type:'rock',icon:'🪨'}},
 123:{1:{name:'Corte X',power:34,cat:'physical',type:'bug',icon:'✂️'}},
 131:{2:{name:'Ice Beam',power:55,type:'ice',icon:'❄️'}},
 134:{2:{name:'Hydro Pump',power:55,type:'water',icon:'🌊'}},
 135:{1:{name:'Fagulha',power:32,type:'electric',icon:'⚡'}},
 149:{2:{name:'Dragon Pulse',power:57,type:'dragon',icon:'🐉'}},
 150:{1:{name:'Confusion',power:35,type:'psychic',icon:'🔮'},2:{name:'Psystrike',power:59,type:'psychic',icon:'🌌'}},
 151:{2:{name:'Poder de Mew',power:56,type:'psychic',icon:'✨'}}
};
const v26OldSkillSet=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){const a=v26OldSkillSet(m),moves=V26_MOVESETS[m.id];
 if(moves)for(const [i,props] of Object.entries(moves))a[Number(i)]={...a[Number(i)],...props};
 return a;
};

// Named move and species-specific cast FX, only when an attack is actually accepted.
const v26OldUseMove=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||current().hp<=0)return;
 const move=skillSet(current())[i],now=performance.now();
 if(cooldowns[i]>now||battle.energy<move.cost)return;
 const monId=current().id;
 this.v26Label('player',move.name.toUpperCase(),TYPE_COLOR[move.type]||'#ffffff','move');
 this.v26CastFx('player',move.type,monId,i===2);
 return v26OldUseMove.call(this,i);
};

// Real changes to combat stats + immunity feedback for status conditions.
const v26OldStatus=BattleEngine.prototype.v25ApplyStatus;
BattleEngine.prototype.v25ApplyStatus=function(s){
 const info=V25_STATUS[s.name];
 if(!info)return v26OldStatus.call(this,s);
 const d=D[foe().id];
 if(info.mode==='condition' && ((info.effect==='paralysis'&&(d.type==='ground'||d.type2==='ground'))||
   (info.effect==='poison'&&['poison','steel'].some(t=>d.type===t||d.type2===t)))){
   this.v26Label('enemy','NÃO AFETA','#d0dced','immune');
   log(`${D[current().id].name} usou ${s.name}, mas não afeta ${d.name}.`);
   return true;
 }
 const side=info.mode==='buff'||info.mode==='reset'?'player':'enemy';
 const before={...this.v25.stats[side]};
 const idx=this.v25.impactMessage.length;
 const ok=v26OldStatus.call(this,s);
 if(!ok)return ok;
 // Replace the large V25 status popup with smaller popups placed beside the creature.
 this.v25.impactMessage.splice(idx);
 if(info.mode==='condition'){
   const cc=info.effect==='poison'?'#d6a2ff':info.effect==='paralysis'?'#fff2a1':'#ffd3f5';
   this.v26Label('enemy',info.label,cc,'condition');
 }else if(info.mode==='reset'){
   this.v26Label('player','ATRIBUTOS NORMALIZADOS','#a2f7e1','status');
 }else{
   this.v26Label(side,info.mode==='buff'?'MELHORIA DE ATRIBUTOS':'REDUÇÃO DE ATRIBUTOS',
    info.mode==='buff'?'#b6ffe1':'#ffc9a3','status');
   const st=this.v25.stats[side];
   for(const k of ['atk','def','speed','accuracy']){
     if(Math.abs(st[k]-before[k])<.001)continue;
     const val=st[k]-before[k];
     const mark=val>=0?'+':'−';
     this.v26Label(side,`${V26_STAT_NAMES[k]} ${mark}${v26Fmt(Math.abs(val))} · x${v26Fmt(st[k])}`,val>=0?'#aeffce':'#ffceac','stat');
   }
 }
 return ok;
};

// Show combo and type effectiveness only after real damage; critical increases actual damage.
const v26OldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 const side=who;
 const mon=who==='enemy'?foe():current();
 const id=who==='enemy'?current().id:foe().id;
 const actor=side==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
 if(actor.inv>0)return v26OldHit.call(this,who,type,power);
 const multi=advantage(type,D[mon.id]);
 const hpBefore=mon.hp;
 const crit=multi>0&&Math.random()<.105;
 const rawPower=power*(crit?1.37:1);
 const result=v26OldHit.call(this,who,type,rawPower);
 const hpAfter=mon.hp;
 const damageDealt=Math.max(0,hpBefore-hpAfter);
 if(multi===0){this.v26Label(side,'NÃO AFETA','#d7e2ec','immune');return result}
 if(damageDealt>0){
  if(multi>=1.8)this.v26Label(side,'SUPER EFETIVO!','#ffe18b','effect');
  else if(multi>0&&multi<=.6)this.v26Label(side,'POUCO EFETIVO','#b7c9df','effect');
  if(crit)this.v26Label(side,'ACERTO CRÍTICO!','#ffe6a6','crit');
  if(who==='player'){
   this.v26Combo.hits=0;
   this.v26Combo.last=-99;
  }else{
   const within=this.time-this.v26Combo.last<=2.7;
   this.v26Combo.hits=within?Math.min(99,this.v26Combo.hits+1):1;
   this.v26Combo.last=this.time;
   this.v26Label(side,`COMBO x${this.v26Combo.hits}`,'#b7fce4','combo');
  }
  this.v26ImpactFx(side,type,id,crit);
 }
 return result;
};

// Enemy attack labels + small elemental circles, not exaggerated beams.
const v26OldUpdateBattle=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const old=this.telegraph;
 const prevEnergy=battle?.energy;
 const result=v26OldUpdateBattle.call(this,dt,now);
 const t=this.telegraph;
 if(battle?.active&&t&&t!==old&&t.from==='enemy'){
   const id=foe().id,type=t.type||D[id].type;
   const move=skillSet(foe())[t.kind==='beam'?2:1];
   this.v26Label('enemy',move.name.toUpperCase(),TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#ffffff','move');
   this.v26CastFx('enemy',type,id,t.kind==='beam');
 }
 return result;
};


/* V26+: richer small stadium props; cosmetic items are never targeting/collision objects. */
BattleEngine.prototype.v26DrawProps=function(c){
 const w=this.w,h=this.h,type=GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)].type;
 // Eight to twelve small scene details on edges, leaving the central lane clear.
 const spots=[[.07,.35,.75],[.22,.37,.70],[.40,.35,.60],[.61,.36,.65],[.79,.37,.74],[.93,.37,.64],
  [.075,.61,.80],[.94,.62,.79],[.11,.84,1.0],[.22,.88,.74],[.49,.84,.55],[.79,.86,.85],[.91,.85,.87]];
 const theme={
  flying:{accent:'#e1efff',secondary:'#9bc7db',kind:'flag'},
  water:{accent:'#b8efff',secondary:'#6dcbf5',kind:'coral'},
  electric:{accent:'#ffe67c',secondary:'#d2a845',kind:'coil'},
  grass:{accent:'#baf49b',secondary:'#5eb88e',kind:'leaf'},
  poison:{accent:'#e6baff',secondary:'#9064aa',kind:'mushroom'},
  psychic:{accent:'#ffd2f7',secondary:'#b98ee3',kind:'crystal'},
  fire:{accent:'#ffd1a1',secondary:'#ff784a',kind:'flame'},
  ground:{accent:'#eee2bf',secondary:'#ac9a7e',kind:'rock'},
 }[type]||{accent:'#d9e8ef',secondary:'#7f9ba2',kind:'rock'};
 c.save();
 spots.forEach((q,i)=>{
  const [nx,ny,small]=q,x=w*nx,y=h*ny;
  const sz=Math.min(17,Math.max(5,h*.029*small));
  c.save();c.translate(x,y);
  c.globalAlpha=(i<6?.62:.78);
  c.fillStyle='#06131b55';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,sz*.36,sz*.90,sz*.28,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
  if(theme.kind==='leaf'){
   c.strokeStyle=theme.secondary;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,sz*.17);
   for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,sz*.28);c.quadraticCurveTo(k*sz*.45,-sz*.18,k*sz*.64,-sz*(.68+.04*(k+1)));c.stroke()}
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){c.beginPath();c.ellipse(k*sz*.40,-sz*.33,sz*.27,sz*.14,k*.38,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}
  }else if(theme.kind==='flame'){
   c.fillStyle='#765342';c.fillRect(-sz*.25,sz*.08,sz*.5,sz*.27);
   c.fillStyle=theme.secondary;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-sz*.90);c.quadraticCurveTo(sz*.65,-sz*.15,sz*.24,sz*.15);c.quadraticCurveTo(-sz*.4,sz*.14,-sz*.21,-sz*.25);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-sz*.19,sz*.18,sz*.36,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  }else if(theme.kind==='coil'){
   c.strokeStyle=theme.secondary;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,sz*.19);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-sz*.55,sz*.2);c.lineTo(-sz*.55,-sz*.52);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-sz*1.0,sz*.55,-sz*.52);c.lineTo(sz*.55,sz*.2);c.stroke();
   c.strokeStyle=theme.accent;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1,sz*.14);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-sz*.55,-sz*.45);c.lineTo(sz*.55,-sz*.45);c.stroke();
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-sz*.48,sz*.18,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  }else if(theme.kind==='crystal'){
   c.fillStyle=theme.secondary;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-sz);c.lineTo(sz*.48,-sz*.22);c.lineTo(sz*.25,sz*.25);c.lineTo(-sz*.32,sz*.25);c.lineTo(-sz*.49,-sz*.24);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,-sz);c.lineTo(sz*.16,-sz*.15);c.lineTo(0,sz*.18);c.lineTo(-sz*.32,sz*.25);c.lineTo(-sz*.49,-sz*.24);c.closePath();c.fill();
  }else if(theme.kind==='coral'){
   c.strokeStyle=theme.secondary;c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.5,sz*.21);
   c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,sz*.28);c.lineTo(0,-sz*.71);c.moveTo(0,-sz*.2);c.lineTo(-sz*.48,-sz*.57);c.moveTo(0,-sz*.3);c.lineTo(sz*.45,-sz*.72);c.stroke();
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++){c.beginPath();c.arc(k*sz*.35,-sz*(k===0?.71:.58),sz*.14,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()}
  }else if(theme.kind==='mushroom'){
   c.fillStyle='#e5d4eb';c.fillRect(-sz*.12,-sz*.25,sz*.24,sz*.55);
   c.fillStyle=theme.secondary;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-sz*.35,sz*.62,sz*.37,0,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.fillStyle=theme.accent;c.beginPath();c.arc(-sz*.22,-sz*.43,sz*.12,0,Math.PI*2);c.arc(sz*.22,-sz*.42,sz*.10,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  }else if(theme.kind==='flag'){
   c.strokeStyle='#e0e8f0a0';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,sz*.25);c.lineTo(0,-sz*.88);c.stroke();
   c.fillStyle=theme.secondary;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(1,-sz*.83);c.lineTo(sz*.64,-sz*.68);c.lineTo(sz*.07,-sz*.41);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.strokeStyle=theme.accent;c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sz*.14,-sz*.71);c.lineTo(sz*.43,-sz*.64);c.stroke();
  }else{
   c.fillStyle=theme.secondary;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-sz*.60,sz*.16);c.lineTo(-sz*.28,-sz*.54);c.lineTo(sz*.25,-sz*.66);c.lineTo(sz*.61,-sz*.13);c.lineTo(sz*.38,sz*.20);c.closePath();c.fill();
   c.strokeStyle=theme.accent;c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-sz*.28,-sz*.42);c.lineTo(sz*.20,-sz*.52);c.stroke();
  }
  c.restore();
 });
 c.restore();
};

/* V26.1: Evoluções, Earthquake e estabilidade da Faísca — 2D Canvas */
const V27_EVO_PARENT={};
for(const spec of Object.values(D))if(spec.evolve&&D[spec.evolve])V27_EVO_PARENT[spec.evolve]=spec.id;
function v27EvoDepth(id){let depth=0;const visited=new Set();while(V27_EVO_PARENT[id]&&!visited.has(id)&&depth<3){visited.add(id);id=V27_EVO_PARENT[id];depth++}return depth}
const V27_MOVE_RANK={
 normal:['Ataque Rápido','Ataque Veloz','Impacto Supersônico'],
 fire:['Brasa','Roda de Fogo','Lança-Chamas'],water:['Pistola d’Água','Jato d’Água','Surf'],
 grass:['Chicote de Vinha','Folha Navalha','Tempestade de Folhas'],electric:['Choque do Trovão','Faísca','Descarga Elétrica'],
 ground:['Mud Shot','Poder Terrestre','Magnitude'],rock:['Rock Throw','Rock Blast','Avalanche'],
 flying:['Ataque de Asa','Golpe Aéreo','Furacão'],psychic:['Confusão','Psybeam','Psíquico'],
 poison:['Ácido','Venoshock','Bomba de Lodo'],ice:['Ice Shard','Ice Fang','Ice Beam'],
 fighting:['Karate Chop','Mach Punch','Close Combat'],ghost:['Night Shade','Hex','Shadow Ball'],
 bug:['Fury Cutter','Bug Bite','Megahorn'],steel:['Metal Claw','Steel Wing','Iron Head'],
 dragon:['Dragon Breath','Dragon Claw','Dragon Pulse'],dark:['Bite','Crunch','Dark Pulse'],fairy:['Fairy Wind','Draining Kiss','Dazzling Gleam']
};
const v27PriorSkillSet=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){
 const moves=v27PriorSkillSet(m);const depth=v27EvoDepth(m.id);
 if(depth){
  const signature=V26_MOVESETS[m.id]||{};
  moves[0]={...moves[0],name:depth>=2?'Golpe Veloz+':'Golpe Veloz',power:16+depth*5};
  if(!signature[1])moves[1]={...moves[1],name:(V27_MOVE_RANK[moves[1].type]||V27_MOVE_RANK.normal)[Math.min(depth,2)]};
  moves[1]={...moves[1],power:Math.min(49,moves[1].power+depth*3)};
  moves[2]={...moves[2],power:Math.min(68,moves[2].power+depth*4)};
 }
 // Tremor é uma onda pelo solo. Jamais um laser ou projétil.
 for(const move of moves)if(move.name==='Earthquake')move.kind='quake';
 return moves;
};
// Identificar imediatamente os golpes renovados quando a espécie evolui.
const v27PriorAwardXP=awardXP;
awardXP=function(m,amount){
 const beforeId=m.id;const oldMoves=skillSet(m).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.name);
 const notes=v27PriorAwardXP(m,amount);
 if(m.id!==beforeId){
  const newMoves=skillSet(m).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.name);
  const improved=newMoves.filter((name,i)=>name!==oldMoves[i]);
  notes.push('Golpes evoluídos: '+(improved.length?improved.join(', '):'potência aumentada'));
 }
 return notes;
};
const v27PriorUseMove=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||current()?.hp<=0)return;
 const move=skillSet(current())[i];if(move?.kind!=='quake')return v27PriorUseMove.call(this,i);
 const now=performance.now();if(cooldowns[i]>now||battle.energy<move.cost)return;
 cooldowns[i]=now+move.cd;battle.energy-=move.cost;
 this.v27Quakes ||= [];
 this.v27Quakes.push({age:0,duration:.84,x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y,power:move.power,hit:false,phase:Math.random()*10});
 this.attackActs.player=this.time+.55;
 this.v26Label('player','EARTHQUAKE · TERREMOTO','#ffe0aa','move');
 this.v26CastFx('player','ground',current().id,true);
 this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y,'#d6c5a1',20,75);
 this.shake=Math.max(this.shake,6);
 log(`${D[current().id].name} usou Earthquake! O chão está tremendo!`);playSound('hit');
};
const v27PriorUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const result=v27PriorUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.v27Quakes?.length)return result;
 for(const quake of this.v27Quakes){
  quake.age+=dt;
  this.shake=Math.max(this.shake,(1-quake.age/quake.duration)*5);
  if(!quake.hit&&quake.age>=.22){
   quake.hit=true;
   this.rings.push({x:quake.x,y:quake.y,r:6,life:.38,color:'#e0bc88'});
   this.particlesAt(quake.x,quake.y,'#d6a77f',28,120);
   this.hitTarget('enemy','ground',quake.power);
  }
 }
 this.v27Quakes=this.v27Quakes.filter(q=>q.age<q.duration);
 return result;
};
const v27PriorDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
 v27PriorDraw.call(this,now);
 if(!this.v27Quakes?.length)return;
 const c=this.ctx;
 for(const q of this.v27Quakes){
  const t=Math.min(1,q.age/q.duration),fade=Math.max(0,1-t);
  const range=this.h*(.05+.23*t);
  c.save();c.globalAlpha=.82*fade;c.translate(q.x,q.y+this.h*.025);
  c.lineJoin='round';c.lineCap='round';
  for(let arm=0;arm<7;arm++){
   const angle=arm*2*Math.PI/7+q.phase;
   const length=range*(.70+.24*Math.sin(arm*13+q.phase));
   c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,0);
   for(let j=1;j<=5;j++){
    const f=j/5,normal=Math.sin(arm*9+j*15+q.phase)*length*.14;
    c.lineTo(Math.cos(angle)*length*f-Math.sin(angle)*normal,Math.sin(angle)*length*f*.39+Math.cos(angle)*normal*.5);
   }
   c.strokeStyle='#24212a';c.lineWidth=Math.max(2,this.h*.011*(1-t*.48));c.stroke();
   c.strokeStyle='#d6a06c';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.8,this.h*.003);c.stroke();
  }
  c.strokeStyle='#f6cd8d';c.lineWidth=Math.max(1.4,this.h*.007);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,range,range*.27,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
  for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
   const a=i*2*Math.PI/10+q.phase,r=range*(.38+.5*Math.sin(i*3+q.phase)**2);
   c.fillStyle=i%2?'#ad8b66':'#f0cda4';c.beginPath();c.arc(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r*.30,Math.max(1.1,this.h*.0038*(1-t)),0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
  }
  c.restore();
 }
};
// Proteção extra: transições de inimigo não devem remover projéteis durante o loop de colisões.
// A correção estrutural é aplicada diretamente nos dois filtros do motor base.

// Distribuição única: a mesma tabela alimenta o sorteio e o painel de chances.
function v27WildOdds(g){
 const gym=GYMS[Math.min(g,7)];const buckets=[{ids:gym.wild,share:55},{ids:KANTO_ZONES[g]||[],share:30},{ids:DETAILED_SHOWCASE[g]||[],share:15}];
 const weights=new Map();
 for(const b of buckets){const ids=[...new Set(b.ids)].filter(id=>D[id]&&id>=1&&id<=151&&!KANTO_LEGENDS.has(id));if(!ids.length)continue;for(const id of ids)weights.set(id,(weights.get(id)||0)+b.share/ids.length);}
 const all=[...weights.entries()].map(([id,weight])=>({id,name:D[id].name,weight})).sort((a,b)=>b.weight-a.weight||a.id-b.id);
 const total=all.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.weight,0)||1;
 return all.map(m=>({...m,pct:m.weight/total*100}));
}
function v27ChooseWild(g){const options=v27WildOdds(g);let roll=Math.random()*options.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.weight,0);for(const p of options){roll-=p.weight;if(roll<=0)return p.id;}return options[options.length-1]?.id||16;}

const V27_FX_PALETTE={electric:0xffe374,water:0x74d7ff,fire:0xff8d59,grass:0x8ced9d,ice:0xb7f8ff,ground:0xd5b17f,rock:0xcdbda8,psychic:0xd9a8ff,ghost:0xba9cff,poison:0xba8add,dragon:0xa9a2ff};
let v27PhaserPromise=null;
function v27LoadPhaser(){
 if(window.Phaser)return Promise.resolve(window.Phaser);
 if(v27PhaserPromise)return v27PhaserPromise;
 v27PhaserPromise=new Promise(resolve=>{let s=document.createElement('script');s.src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@3.90.0/dist/phaser.min.js';s.async=true;s.onload=()=>resolve(window.Phaser||null);s.onerror=()=>resolve(null);document.head.appendChild(s);});
 return v27PhaserPromise;
}
let v27Scene=null,v27PhaserGame=null,v27BattleToken=0;
function v27DestroyPhaser(){v27BattleToken++;v27Scene=null;if(v27PhaserGame){try{v27PhaserGame.destroy(true)}catch(e){}v27PhaserGame=null;}const el=document.getElementById('v27FxStage');if(el)el.remove();}
function v27SetupPhaser(){
 const token=++v27BattleToken,arena=$('arenaPro');if(!arena)return;
 v27LoadPhaser().then(P=>{
  if(!P||token!==v27BattleToken||!battle?.active||!$('arenaPro'))return;
  const parent=document.createElement('div');parent.id='v27FxStage';parent.className='v27FxStage';arena.insertBefore(parent,arena.querySelector('.arenaTint'));
  try{
   v27PhaserGame=new P.Game({type:P.AUTO,parent,transparent:true,width:Math.max(270,arena.clientWidth),height:Math.max(250,arena.clientHeight),fps:{target:35,forceSetTimeOut:false},render:{antialias:true,pixelArt:false},scale:{mode:P.Scale.RESIZE},scene:{create(){v27Scene=this;const g=this.make.graphics({x:0,y:0},false);g.fillStyle(0xffffff,1);g.fillCircle(5,5,5);g.generateTexture('v27particle',10,10);g.destroy();}},callbacks:{postBoot:()=>{}}});
  }catch(e){console.warn('Phaser 2D indisponível, Canvas ativo',e);v27Scene=null;}
 });
}
function v27EmitFx(kind='electric',side='enemy',power=1){
 if(!v27Scene||!v27Scene.sys.isActive())return;
 try{
  const sc=v27Scene,cv=$('arenaPro');if(!cv)return;
  const x=(side==='enemy'?.76:.24)*cv.clientWidth,y=(side==='enemy'?.47:.63)*cv.clientHeight;
  const color=V27_FX_PALETTE[kind]||0xffffff;const count= Math.min(22,Math.ceil(8+power*7));
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const a=i*2*Math.PI/count+Math.random()*.27,r=12+power*(18+Math.random()*39);
   const obj=sc.add.image(x,y,'v27particle').setTint(color).setAlpha(.8).setScale(.25+Math.random()*.4);
   sc.tweens.add({targets:obj,x:x+Math.cos(a)*r,y:y+Math.sin(a)*r*.75,alpha:0,scale:0,duration:400+Math.random()*250,ease:'Cubic.Out',onComplete:()=>obj.destroy()});
  }
 }catch(e){console.warn('Efeito Phaser falhou; usando Canvas',e)}
}
const v27PrevStart=startBattle;
startBattle=function(enemies,label,wild){v27DestroyPhaser();v27PrevStart(enemies,label,wild);if(battle?.active)v27SetupPhaser();};
const v27PrevStop=stopTimers;
stopTimers=function(){v27DestroyPhaser();return v27PrevStop();};
const v27PrevUse=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 const s=skillSet(current())[i],now=performance.now();const allowed=battle?.active&&!battle.paused&&current()?.hp>0&&now>=(cooldowns[i]||0)&&battle.energy>=s.cost;
 const r=v27PrevUse.call(this,i);

const v28PriorSkillSet=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){
 const skills=v28PriorSkillSet(m);
 const type=D[m.id]?.type||'normal';
 const [name,t,kind,icon,power,cd]=V28_BASIC_SPECIES[m.id]||V28_BASIC_BY_TYPE[type]||V28_BASIC_BY_TYPE.normal;
 skills[0]={name,type:t,cat:kind==='dash'?'physical':'special',power,cost:0,cd,kind,icon};
 return skills;
};
// Damage + distance são compilados em C++. Fallback JS idêntico quando WASM não existir.
const v28PriorDamage=damage;
damage=function(attacker,defender,type,power){
 if(!v28Wasm?.battle_damage)return v28PriorDamage(attacker,defender,type,power);
 const a=D[attacker.id],d=D[defender.id],mult=advantage(type||'normal',d),stab=(type===a.type||type===a.type2)?1.35:1;
 const variation=.88+Math.random()*.23;
 const hit=v28Wasm.battle_damage(a.atk,d.def,attacker.level,defender.level,power,stab,mult,variation);
 return {hit:Math.max(0,hit),mult};
};
const v28PriorDist=BattleEngine.prototype.dist;
BattleEngine.prototype.dist=function(a,b){

 return Math.sqrt(v28Wasm.distance_squared(a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y));

function v28CaptureChance(){return Math.round(30+Math.random()*60);}
function v28SelectLeaderGift(leaderIndex){
 const roster=V28_KANTO_LEADERS[leaderIndex].ids;
 return roster[Math.floor(Math.random()*roster.length)];
}
// Sorteia a chance uma vez ANTES do combate e premia no máximo um Pokémon POR INSÍGNIA.
const v28PriorStartBattle=startBattle;
startBattle=function(enemies,label,wild){
 v28PriorStartBattle(enemies,label,wild);
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 const isLeader=!wild&&save.gym<8&&save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)&&label.includes('LÍDER');
 if(!isLeader)return;
 battle.v28LeaderIndex=save.gym;
 battle.v28LeaderChance=v28CaptureChance();
 const chip=document.createElement('div');chip.className='v28ChanceChip';chip.id='v28ChanceChip';
 chip.textContent=`🎁 Pokémon surpresa · chance ${battle.v28LeaderChance}%`;
 document.querySelector('.battleHeading')?.appendChild(chip);
};
const v28PriorFinishBattle=finishBattle;
finishBattle=function(win){
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 const g=battle.v28LeaderIndex,chance=battle.v28LeaderChance;
 // Guards: wild/treinadores normais nunca geram Pokémon de líder.
 const eligible=win&&Number.isInteger(g)&&g>=0&&g<8&&Number.isFinite(chance)&&save.gym===g&&save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym);
 const giftRoll=eligible?Math.random()*100:null;
 const giftSpec=eligible&&giftRoll<chance?v28SelectLeaderGift(g):null;
 v28PriorFinishBattle(win);
 if(!eligible)return;
 let resultLine;
 if(giftSpec){
  const [id,level]=giftSpec;
  const reward=mon(id,level);
  if(save.team.length<6)save.team.push(reward);
  else save.box.push(reward);
  if(!save.seen.includes(id))save.seen.push(id);
  if(!save.caught.includes(id))save.caught.push(id);
  persist();
  resultLine=`🎁 CHANCE ${chance}% · VOCÊ GANHOU ${D[id].name.toUpperCase()} Nv.${level}! ${save.team.includes(reward)?'Foi para sua equipe.':'Foi para a caixa.'}`;
 }else{
  resultLine=`🎲 CHANCE ${chance}% · não veio Pokémon surpresa desta vez. A insígnia e os prêmios normais estão garantidos.`;
 }
 const result=document.querySelector('#modal .result');
 if(result){
  const bonus=document.createElement('div');bonus.className='v28LeaderGift'+(giftSpec?' won':'');
  bonus.textContent=resultLine;result.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',bonus);
 }
};
// O jogo continua 2D e single-player; Phaser controla apenas partículas opcionais.
// PixiJS não é empilhado com Phaser: dois renderizadores causariam sobreposição e maior consumo.
const v28PriorRender=render;
render=function(){
 v28PriorRender();
 if(save.gym>=8)return;
 const title=document.querySelector('.gymHero .leader');
 const team=V28_KANTO_LEADERS[save.gym];
 if(title&&team){
  const info=document.createElement('div');info.className='v28LeaderRoster';
  info.textContent='👑 '+team.ids.map(([id,level])=>D[id].name+' Nv.'+level).join(' · ');
  title.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',info);
 }
 if(save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)){
  const row=document.querySelector('.actionRow');
  if(row){const line=document.createElement('div');line.className='v28GymGiftHint';line.textContent='🎁 Ao vencer este líder, sorteie 1 Pokémon da equipe dele com chance entre 30% e 90%.';row.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',line);}
 }
};

// V28_1_CLEANUP: menu discreto, com backup e reset com dupla confirmacao.
(function(){
 const v281Render=render;
 function v281OpenSettings(){
  if(battle)return;
  overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">POKÉMON TORRE · CONFIGURAÇÕES</div><h2>⚙️ Opções</h2></div><button class="btn tiny ghost" id="v281Close">✕</button></div><p class="desc">Seu progresso é salvo automaticamente neste navegador. Salve uma cópia antes de reiniciar, se desejar.</p><div class="v281SettingsActions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="v281Backup">💾 Baixar backup</button><button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="v281Exit">Voltar ao jogo</button></div><hr class="divider"><p class="desc">Nova jornada: apaga equipe, caixa, moedas, insígnias e progresso da campanha deste navegador.</p><button type="button" class="btn ghost v281Danger" id="v281Restart">↻ Reiniciar campanha</button>`);
  $('v281Close').onclick=close;
  $('v281Exit').onclick=close;
  $('v281Backup').onclick=()=>{
   const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(save,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
   const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
   a.href=u;a.download='pokemon-torre-backup-antes-reset.json';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
   setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),2000);
  };
  $('v281Restart').onclick=()=>{
   const phrase=prompt('Para apagar a campanha, digite REINICIAR (em letras maiúsculas):','');
   if(phrase!=='REINICIAR')return;
   if(!confirm('Apagar definitivamente sua equipe, moedas e todas as insígnias? O reset não poderá ser desfeito sem um backup.'))return;
   stopTimers();battle=null;
   save=defaultSave();persist();close();render();
  };
 }
 render=function(){
  v281Render();
  if(battle)return;
  const host=$('resources');
  if(host && !$('v281SettingsButton')){
   const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.id='v281SettingsButton';
   btn.type='button';btn.className='v281OptionsButton';btn.textContent='⚙️';
   btn.title='Opções da campanha';btn.setAttribute('aria-label','Opções da campanha');
   btn.onclick=v281OpenSettings;
   host.appendChild(btn);
  }
 };
})();

.moncard .spritewrap:not(:has(img.sprite))::after,.dexCard .spritewrap:not(:has(img.sprite))::after,.list [data-team] .spritewrap:not(:has(img.sprite))::after,.v27Odds .spritewrap:not(:has(img.sprite))::after{content:'?';font:700 14px system-ui;color:#6b91a6;position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px dashed #35516a60;border-radius:10px}
.moncard .spritewrap{width:64px!important;height:64px!important}.dexCard .spritewrap{width:60px!important;height:60px!important}
.list [data-team] .spritewrap,.swapgrid .spritewrap{width:52px!important;height:52px!important;min-width:52px!important}
.v27Odds .spritewrap{width:30px!important;height:30px!important}
.v29DexDetail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(100px,160px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start}
.v29DexArt{display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #375970;border-radius:17px;background:#172d42;padding:10px;min-height:146px}.v29DexArt .spritewrap{width:110px;height:110px;overflow:hidden}.v29DexArt .placeholder{display:none}
.v29DexFacts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:12px 0}.v29DexFacts span{border:1px solid #36546f;background:#152b3e;color:#d7e8f4;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}
.dexCard.v29DexClickable{cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .18s,transform .18s}.dexCard.v29DexClickable:hover,.dexCard.v29DexClickable:focus-visible{border-color:#84d6cf;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.v29BallSelector{background:#132c3d;color:#dff5f5;border:1px solid #4a7890;border-radius:9px;padding:8px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;min-width:90px}
.v29Environment{position:absolute;top:18%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;pointer-events:none;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid #ffffff31;background:#102b3b99;color:#e6f7fe;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;opacity:.78;max-width:55%;text-align:center}
.v29Toast{border:1px solid #638c9c;background:#163246;border-radius:11px;color:#dceff5;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:10px 0}
.v29Endgame{border:1px solid #6c79a9;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#182640,#142b39);margin-top:15px}
.v29EndgameButtons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}.v29EndgameButtons .btn{flex:1 1 120px;font-size:12px}
.v29Info{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#bdd7e8;margin-top:6px}
@media(max-width:580px){.moncard .spritewrap{width:55px!important;height:55px!important}.dexCard .spritewrap{width:48px!important;height:48px!important}.v29DexDetail{grid-template-columns:95px 1fr;gap:10px}.v29DexArt .spritewrap{width:80px;height:80px}.v29DexArt{min-height:112px}.v29Environment{top:19%;font-size:9px;max-width:52%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v27Throw,.v27ThrowBall,.v29DexClickable{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
`;

const v29OldSkills=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){const list=v29OldSkills(m);const sig=V29_SIGNATURES[m.id];if(sig)list[2]={...sig,cat:sig.kind==='dash'?'physical':'special'};return list};

// 2. Animacao de arremesso ja existente: refinamento para nao esconder HP ou interface.
const v29TrainerStyle=document.createElement('style');
v29TrainerStyle.textContent=`.v27Throw{max-width:96px;max-height:98px;bottom:16%;opacity:.95}.v27ThrowTrainer{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px #0008)}.v27Throw.right{right:3%}.v27Throw.left{left:3%}@media(max-width:600px){.v27Throw{transform:scale(.84);transform-origin:bottom left}.v27Throw.right{transform-origin:bottom right}}`;

// 3. Personalidade de cada lider na IA, apenas em batalhas de chefe.
const V29_AI={rock:{tempo:1.1,space:1},water:{tempo:.83,space:1.08},electric:{tempo:.90,space:1.10},grass:{tempo:1.0,space:1},poison:{tempo:.95,space:1.03},psychic:{tempo:.86,space:1.12},fire:{tempo:.90,space:1.04},ground:{tempo:1.16,space:.93},ice:{tempo:.94,space:1.05},fighting:{tempo:.86,space:.96},ghost:{tempo:.92,space:1.08},dragon:{tempo:.87,space:1.04}};
const v29OldEnemy=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const priorCD=this.enemyAttackCD;
 const result=v29OldEnemy.call(this,dt,now);
 if(!battle?.active)return result;
 if((save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym)||save.gym>=8)&&!battle.wild){
  const cfg=V29_AI[GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)]?.type]||{tempo:1,space:1};
  if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD)&&this.enemyAttackCD>1.2&&priorCD<=0.2){this.enemyAttackCD*=cfg.tempo;}
  if(cfg.space>1&&this.dist(this.player,this.enemy)<this.h*.26&&this.foeDodgeCD<.4){this.foeDodgeCD=.4;this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(this.enemyAttackCD,.35);}
 }
 return result;
};

// 4. Tema de arena discreto e leve; nenhuma imagem sobreposta aos Pokemon.
const V29_ARENA_LABELS={rock:'🪨 PISO ROCHOSO',water:'💧 PISCINA',electric:'⚡ USINA',grass:'🌿 JARDIM',poison:'☣️ NÉVOA',psychic:'🔮 MENTE',fire:'🔥 VULCÃO',ground:'⛰️ DESERTO',ice:'❄️ GELO',fighting:'🥊 DOJO',ghost:'👻 SOMBRAS',dragon:'🐉 DRAGÕES'};
const v29OldBattleRender=renderBattle;
renderBattle=function(){
 v29OldBattleRender();
 const arena=$('arenaPro');if(!arena||!battle?.active)return;
 const type=GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)]?.type||'normal';
 const mood=document.createElement('div');mood.className='v29Environment';mood.textContent=V29_ARENA_LABELS[type]||'ARENA 2D';arena.appendChild(mood);
 if(battle.wild)v29CaptureControls();
};

// 5. Efeitos de status adicionais, aplicados sem confundir melhoria com escudo.
Object.assign(V25_STATUS,{
 'Will-O-Wisp':{mode:'condition',effect:'burn',label:'QUEIMADO',detail:'O adversário sofreu queimadura'},
 'Pó de Gelo':{mode:'condition',effect:'freeze',label:'CONGELADO',detail:'O adversário foi congelado temporariamente'}
});
const v29Stats=BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize;
BattleEngine.prototype.v25Initialize=function(){const result=v29Stats.call(this);this.v29StatusClock=0;this.v29FreezeLeft=0;return result};
const v29StatusSkills=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){const out=v29StatusSkills(m);const t=D[m.id]?.type,t2=D[m.id]?.type2;if(t==='fire'){out[3]={name:'Will-O-Wisp',type:'fire',kind:'status',cat:'status',power:0,cost:26,cd:6400,icon:'🔥'}}if(t==='ice'||t2==='ice'){out[3]={name:'Pó de Gelo',type:'ice',kind:'status',cat:'status',power:0,cost:28,cd:6800,icon:'❄️'}}return out};
const v29OldStatusUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const r=v29OldStatusUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.v25?.stats?.enemy)return r;
 const status=this.v25.stats.enemy,conditions=status.conditions||[];
 if(conditions.includes('burn')){this.v29StatusClock=(this.v29StatusClock||0)+dt;
  if(this.v29StatusClock>=3.5){this.v29StatusClock=0;const m=foe();if(m?.hp>1){const d=Math.max(1,Math.floor(m.maxHp*.035));m.hp=Math.max(1,m.hp-d);this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.25,'QUEIMADURA -'+d,'#ffc090')}}}
 if(conditions.includes('freeze')){
  this.v29FreezeLeft=(this.v29FreezeLeft||0)+dt;
  this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(this.enemyAttackCD,.32);
  if(this.v29FreezeLeft>2.5){status.conditions=status.conditions.filter(x=>x!=='freeze');this.v29FreezeLeft=0;this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.25,'DESCONGELOU','#c5f8ff');}
 }
 return r;
};

// 6. Pokedex com detalhes, ataques, evolucoes, rotas e fraquezas calculadas.
function v29DexDetails(id){
 const p=D[id];if(!p)return;
 const types=[p.type,p.type2].filter(Boolean),weak=Object.keys(TYPE_NAME).map(t=>({type:t,adv:advantage(t,p)})).filter(x=>x.adv>1.01).sort((a,b)=>b.adv-a.adv);
 const evolution=p.evolve&&D[p.evolve]?D[p.evolve].name+' (Nv. '+p.at+')':'Sem evolução por nível';
 const routes=[];for(let g=0;g<8;g++){const o=v27WildOdds(g).find(x=>x.id===id);if(o)routes.push('Rota '+(g+1)+' — '+o.pct.toFixed(1).replace('.',',')+'%');}
 const known=save.seen.includes(id)||save.caught.includes(id);if(!known)return;
 const moves=skillSet(mon(id,Math.max(5,Math.min(50,GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,7)].max))));
 overlay(`<div class="sectionhead"><div><div class="overline">POKÉDEX · KANTO</div><h2>#${String(id).padStart(3,'0')} ${p.name}</h2></div><button id="v29DexClose" class="btn tiny ghost">✕</button></div><div class="v29DexDetail"><div class="v29DexArt">${img(id)}</div><div><div class="v29DexFacts"><span>${types.map(t=>TYPE_NAME[t]).join(' / ')}</span><span>HP ${p.hp}</span><span>ATK ${p.atk}</span><span>DEF ${p.def}</span><span>VEL ${p.spd}</span></div><div class="v29Info"><b>Fraquezas:</b> ${weak.length?weak.map(x=>TYPE_NAME[x.type]+' x'+x.adv).join(' · '):'Nenhuma detectada'}.</div><div class="v29Info"><b>Evolução:</b> ${evolution}.</div><div class="v29Info"><b>Golpes:</b> ${moves.map(m=>m.name).join(' · ')}.</div><div class="v29Info"><b>Encontrar:</b> ${routes.length?routes.join(' · '):'Espécie especial, presente em encontros e desafios específicos'}.</div></div></div><button id="v29DexBack" class="btn ghost wide" style="margin-top:15px">← Voltar à Pokédex</button>`);
 $('v29DexClose').onclick=close;$('v29DexBack').onclick=showPokedex;
}
const v29OldDex=showPokedex;
showPokedex=function(){v29OldDex();document.querySelectorAll('.dexGrid .dexCard').forEach((card,i)=>{
 const id=i+1;if(!save.seen.includes(id)&&!save.caught.includes(id))return;
 card.classList.add('v29DexClickable');card.tabIndex=0;card.setAttribute('role','button');card.setAttribute('aria-label','Detalhes de '+D[id].name);
 card.onclick=()=>v29DexDetails(id);card.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();v29DexDetails(id)}};
});};

// 7. Limite adaptativo de particulas no Android e dispositivos em economia de movimento.
const v29OldParticles=BattleEngine.prototype.particlesAt;
BattleEngine.prototype.particlesAt=function(x,y,color,count=18,speed=120){
 const low=(this.fps>0&&this.fps<42)||window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 return v29OldParticles.call(this,x,y,color,Math.min(low?12:28,count),speed);
};

// 8. Backup automatico nao destrutivo. Mantem a chave de save, sem migracao forçada.
const v29OldPersist=persist;
persist=function(){v29OldPersist();try{
 if(save.starter&&Array.isArray(save.team)&&save.team.length){
  const snapshot={time:Date.now(),save:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(save))};
  localStorage.setItem(V29_SAVE_BACKUP_KEY,JSON.stringify(snapshot));
 }
}catch(e){console.warn('Backup automatico nao disponivel',e)}};
const v29OldRender=render;
render=function(){v29OldRender();const gear=$('v281SettingsButton');if(gear&&!gear.dataset.v29){gear.dataset.v29='1';const previous=gear.onclick;gear.onclick=()=>{
 previous?.();const actions=document.querySelector('.v281SettingsActions');if(!actions||$('v29RestoreBackup'))return;
 const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.id='v29RestoreBackup';btn.className='btn ghost';btn.textContent='↺ Recuperar backup automático';actions.appendChild(btn);
 btn.onclick=()=>{try{const obj=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V29_SAVE_BACKUP_KEY)||'null');const data=obj?.save;
 if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.team)||!data.team.length||!Number.isInteger(data.gym)||data.gym<0||data.gym>13)throw Error('Backup inválido');
 if(!confirm('Restaurar o último backup? O progresso atual será substituído.'))return;
 save={...defaultSave(),...data};save.team=save.team.filter(m=>D[m.id]&&m.level>=1).slice(0,6);save.box=(save.box||[]).filter(m=>D[m.id]).slice(0,100);if(!save.team.length)throw Error('Equipe inválida');persist();close();render();
 }catch(e){alert('Não há backup automático válido neste navegador.')}};
 };}};

// 9. Great Ball e Ultra Ball com chances melhores; seletor discreto nas batalhas selvagens.
if(!KANTO_SHOP.some(x=>x.id==='superball'))KANTO_SHOP.push({id:'superball',name:'Super Ball',icon:'🔵',price:28,detail:'Chance de captura 1,35x'});
if(!KANTO_SHOP.some(x=>x.id==='ultraball'))KANTO_SHOP.push({id:'ultraball',name:'Ultra Ball',icon:'🟡',price:52,detail:'Chance de captura 1,7x'});
save.superBalls=Math.max(0,Number(save.superBalls)||0);save.ultraBalls=Math.max(0,Number(save.ultraBalls)||0);
const v29OldShop=showShop;
showShop=function(){v29OldShop();document.querySelectorAll('[data-buy="superball"],[data-buy="ultraball"]').forEach(b=>{b.onclick=()=>{
 const key=b.dataset.buy,item=KANTO_SHOP.find(x=>x.id===key);if(!item||save.coins<item.price)return;
 save.coins-=item.price;if(key==='superball')save.superBalls++;else save.ultraBalls++;persist();render();showShop();
 };});};
function v29AvailableBall(){return ['ball','superball','ultraball'].find(k=>k==='ball'?save.balls>0:k==='superball'?save.superBalls>0:save.ultraBalls>0)||'ball';}
function v29CaptureControls(){const target=$('catchCombat');if(!target)return;
 const options=document.createElement('select');options.id='v29BallSelect';options.className='v29BallSelector';options.setAttribute('aria-label','Escolher Pokébola');
 const stock={ball:save.balls,superball:save.superBalls,ultraball:save.ultraBalls};
 for(const [id,label] of [['ball','🔴 Pokébola'],['superball','🔵 Super Ball'],['ultraball','🟡 Ultra Ball']]){
  const el=document.createElement('option');el.value=id;el.textContent=label+' · '+stock[id];el.disabled=stock[id]<=0;options.appendChild(el);
 }
 options.value=v29AvailableBall();target.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin',options);
 target.textContent='🔴 Capturar';target.disabled=stock.ball+stock.superball+stock.ultraball===0;
 options.onchange=()=>{battle.v29Ball=options.value;target.textContent='🔴 Capturar ('+(options.value==='ultraball'?'Ultra':options.value==='superball'?'Super':'Pokébola')+')';};
};
catchMon=function(){
 if(!battle?.active||!battle.wild||battle.paused||!engine?.v25?.stats)return;
 let id=$('v29BallSelect')?.value||battle.v29Ball||v29AvailableBall();const store=id==='ultraball'?'ultraBalls':id==='superball'?'superBalls':'balls';
 if(!save[store])return;
 const m=foe();if(!m)return;
 const mult=id==='ultraball'?1.7:id==='superball'?1.35:1;
 const rarity=KANTO_LEGENDS.has(m.id)?.53:1;
 const wildConditions=engine?.v25?.stats?.enemy?.conditions||[];
const captureStatusBonus=(m.status==='sleep'||m.status==='freeze'||wildConditions.some(c=>/sleep|freeze|sono|gelo/i.test(c)))?1.32:(m.status==='paralyze'||m.status==='poison'||m.status==='burn'||wildConditions.length>0)?1.17:1;
const chance=Math.max(.05,Math.min(.98,(.17+.72*(1-m.hp/m.maxHp))*mult*rarity*captureStatusBonus));
 save[store]--;persist();
 engine.v25.capture={time:0,duration:1.65,fromX:engine.player.x,fromY:engine.player.y-engine.h*.16,toX:engine.enemy.x,toY:engine.enemy.y-engine.h*.15,success:Math.random()<chance,spark:false,shake:false};
 battle.paused=true;log((id==='ultraball'?'Ultra Ball':id==='superball'?'Super Ball':'Pokébola')+' lançada! Chance '+Math.round(chance*100)+'%');playSound('dash');
 const selector=$('v29BallSelect');if(selector){const option=selector.querySelector(`option[value="${id}"]`);if(option){option.textContent=option.textContent.replace(/\d+$/,save[store]);option.disabled=save[store]===0;}}
};

// 10. Pos-jogo: desafios lendarios apos completar a Elite Four (sem alterar a campanha).
const V29_LEGENDARY=[144,145,146,150,151];
const v29OldWin=renderWin;
renderWin=function(){v29OldWin();if(save.gym<13)return;
 const panel=document.querySelector('#main section');if(!panel)return;
 const block=document.createElement('section');block.className='v29Endgame';
 block.innerHTML='<h3>✨ Desafios lendários de Kanto</h3><p class="desc">Campeão de Kanto: enfrente e tente capturar Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Mewtwo e Mew. Leve Pokébolas e uma equipe preparada.</p><div class="v29EndgameButtons"></div>';
 const row=block.querySelector('.v29EndgameButtons');const mart=document.createElement('button');mart.className='btn gold';mart.textContent='🛍️ Comprar Pokébolas';mart.onclick=showShop;row.appendChild(mart);for(const id of V29_LEGENDARY){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn ghost';b.textContent=D[id].name;b.onclick=()=>{
 if(!requireTeam()){showItems();return}if(save.balls+save.superBalls+save.ultraBalls<1){alert('Compre Pokébolas para iniciar o desafio.');return;}
 startBattle([mon(id,id===150?75:68)],'✨ DESAFIO LENDÁRIO · '+D[id].name,true);
 };row.appendChild(b)}panel.appendChild(block);
};

// As lutas lendarias NAO devem incrementar os ginásios ou a Liga finalizada.
const v29OldFinishBattle=finishBattle;
finishBattle=function(win){
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 if(save.gym===13&&battle.wild){
  const name=foe()?D[foe().id].name:'Pokémon lendário';
  battle.active=false;stopTimers();
  if(win){save.wins++;save.coins+=40;for(const m of save.team){if(m.hp>0){awardXP(m,42);m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.12));}}}
  else{save.losses++;for(const m of save.team)m.hp=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(m.maxHp*.55));}
  persist();resultScreen(win?'✨ DESAFIO LENDÁRIO VENCIDO':'💔 DESAFIO ENCERRADO',win?name+' foi derrotado. Volte para tentar capturá-lo!':'Você pode tentar novamente no pós-jogo.',win,false);
  return;
 }
 return v29OldFinishBattle(win);
};
