// Golpes AOE, teleguiados, atravessantes e temporarios, sem novo loop de requestAnimationFrame.
const v30OriginalMove=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
 const m=current(),s=m&&skillSet(m)[i],b=battle;
 if(!b?.active||b.paused||!s||i!==2||!V30_MOVE_TRAITS[m.id])return v30OriginalMove.call(this,i);
 const now=performance.now();if((cooldowns[i]||0)>now||b.energy<s.cost||m.hp<=0)return;
 b.energy-=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=now+s.cd;this.attackActs.player=this.time+.46;
 this.v30Shots=this.v30Shots||[];this.v30Zones=this.v30Zones||[];
 const aim=this.aimVector(),sx=this.player.x,sy=this.player.y,color=TYPE_COLOR[s.type]||'#f8fbff';
 this.particlesAt(sx+aim.x*15,sy+aim.y*15,color,13,75);
 if(s.kind==='homing'||s.kind==='pierce'){
   if(this.v30Shots.length>14)this.v30Shots.shift();
   this.v30Shots.push({x:sx,y:sy,vx:aim.x*this.h*.60,vy:aim.y*this.h*.60,kind:s.kind,type:s.type,power:s.power,life:1.8,trail:[],hit:false});
 }else if(s.kind==='area'){
   this.v30Zones.push({kind:'area',x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y,type:s.type,power:s.power,life:.42,hit:false,r:this.h*.21});
   this.v19Impacts.push({x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y-this.h*.13,type:s.type,life:.4,max:.4,seed:Math.random()*6.28});
 }else if(s.kind==='hazard'){
   this.v30Zones.push({kind:'hazard',x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y,type:s.type,power:s.power,life:3.1,tick:.4,r:this.h*.18});
 }
 this.v30Zones=this.v30Zones.slice(-8);
 log(D[m.id].name+' usou '+s.name+'!');playSound('move');
 if(typeof v27EmitFx==='function')v27EmitFx(s.type,'enemy',1.4);
 if(typeof v27Cinematic==='function')v27Cinematic(this);
};
const v30OriginalUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const result=v30OriginalUpdate.call(this,dt,now);if(!battle?.active)return result;
 // Montado no loop existente, com delta em segundos e limites rígidos de partículas.
 if(this.v30Shots){for(let j=this.v30Shots.length-1;j>=0;j--){const o=this.v30Shots[j];
  o.life-=dt;if(o.life<=0){this.v30Shots.splice(j,1);continue;}
  if(o.kind==='homing'&&foe()?.hp>0){let dx=this.enemy.x-o.x,dy=this.enemy.y-o.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
   const speed=this.h*.58;o.vx=o.vx*.82+dx/len*speed*.18;o.vy=o.vy*.82+dy/len*speed*.18;}
  o.x+=o.vx*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt;o.trail.push({x:o.x,y:o.y});if(o.trail.length>7)o.trail.shift();
  if(Math.hypot(o.x-this.enemy.x,o.y-this.enemy.y)<this.h*.085){this.hitTarget('enemy',o.type,o.power);o.hit=true;this.v30Shots.splice(j,1);}
 }}
 if(this.v30Zones){for(let j=this.v30Zones.length-1;j>=0;j--){const z=this.v30Zones[j];z.life-=dt;
  if(z.kind==='area'&&!z.hit){z.hit=true;if(this.dist({x:z.x,y:z.y},this.enemy)<z.r){this.hitTarget('enemy',z.type,z.power);}}
  if(z.kind==='hazard'){z.tick-=dt;if(z.tick<=0){z.tick=.68;if(this.dist({x:z.x,y:z.y},this.enemy)<z.r)this.hitTarget('enemy',z.type,z.power);}}
  if(z.life<=0)this.v30Zones.splice(j,1);
 }}
 // Fases do chefe: reduz o intervalo entre golpes, sem inflar HP nem dano bruto.
 if(battle.v30Boss&&battle.v30Phase>=2&&this.enemyAttackCD>1.8)this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(1.1,this.enemyAttackCD-.2*dt);
 return result;
};
const v30OriginalDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
 v30OriginalDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||(!this.v30Shots?.length&&!this.v30Zones?.length))return;
 const c=this.ctx;c.save();
 for(const z of this.v30Zones||[]){c.save();c.globalAlpha=Math.min(.42,Math.max(0,z.life))*.65;c.strokeStyle=TYPE_COLOR[z.type]||'#dcecff';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(z.x,z.y,z.r,z.r*.35,0,0,7);c.stroke();c.restore();}
 for(const p of this.v30Shots||[]){c.save();c.globalAlpha=.88;c.strokeStyle=TYPE_COLOR[p.type]||'#ebf5ff';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();let last=p.trail[0]||p;c.moveTo(last.x,last.y);for(const q of p.trail)c.lineTo(q.x,q.y);c.stroke();c.fillStyle=TYPE_COLOR[p.type]||'#ebf5ff';c.beginPath();if(p.type!=='electric'&&!p.v343Signature){c.arc(p.x,p.y,4.2,0,7);c.fill();}c.restore();}
 c.restore();
};

// Estilos de liderança e fases no último Pokémon; fases são progresso real da equipe do líder.
function v30BossName(){if(!battle?.active)return '';const g=Math.min(save.gym,12);return GYMS[g]?.leader||'Chefe';}
function v30PhaseView(){const el=$('arenaPro');if(!el||!battle?.v30Boss)return;
 let tag=el.querySelector('#v30BossPhase');if(!tag){tag=document.createElement('div');tag.id='v30BossPhase';tag.className='v30BossPhase';el.append(tag);}
 tag.textContent='👑 '+v30BossName()+' · FASE '+battle.v30Phase+'/'+battle.v30Total+' · '+(battle.enemies.length===0?'POKÉMON FINAL':'Estratégia adaptativa');
}
const v30OriginalStart=startBattle;
startBattle=function(enemies,label,wild){
 v30OriginalStart(enemies,label,wild);
 if(!battle?.active)return;
 const boss=!wild&&((save.gym<8&&save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym))||save.gym>=8);
 battle.v30Boss=boss;battle.v30Phase=1;battle.v30Total=1+battle.enemies.length;
 battle.v30MissionFaint=0;
 if(boss){v30PhaseView();const monId=foe()?.id;if(monId){const abil=v30Ability(monId);if(abil==='Intimidate'){const st=engine?.v25?.stats?.player;if(st)st.atk=Math.max(.60,(st.atk||1)-.12);}}}
};
const v30OriginalNext=nextFoe;
nextFoe=function(){
 const boss=battle?.v30Boss;
 const result=v30OriginalNext();if(boss&&battle?.active){battle.v30Phase=Math.min(battle.v30Total,(battle.v30Phase||1)+1);v30PhaseView();}
 return result;
};

// Habilidades: Static, Levitate, Intimidate, Overgrow, Blaze e Torrent.
const V30_ABILITY={
 Intimidate:new Set([23,24,58,59,130,142]), Levitate:new Set([92,93,94,109,110]),
 Static:new Set([25,26,100,101,125,135,81,82]), Overgrow:new Set([1,2,3,43,44,45,69,70,71]),
 Blaze:new Set([4,5,6,37,38,58,59,77,78]), Torrent:new Set([7,8,9,60,61,62,72,73,120,121,129,130])
};
function v30Ability(id){for(const [k,values] of Object.entries(V30_ABILITY))if(values.has(id))return k;return '—';}
const v30OriginalDamage=damage;
damage=function(attacker,defender,type,power){
 const r=v30OriginalDamage(attacker,defender,type,power);if(!attacker||!defender)return r;
 const allyMon=battle?.active?current():null;
 const atkStat=allyMon&&attacker===allyMon?sideState('ally'):sideState('enemy');
 const defStat=allyMon&&defender===allyMon?sideState('ally'):sideState('enemy');
 r.hit=Math.max(0,Math.round(r.hit * Math.max(.45,1+(atkStat.atk||0)*.14) / Math.max(.45,1+(defStat.def||0)*.14)));
 if(type==='ground'&&v30Ability(defender.id)==='Levitate'){r.hit=0;r.mult=0;return r;}
 const ab=v30Ability(attacker.id),low=attacker.hp<=attacker.maxHp/3;
 if(low&&((ab==='Blaze'&&type==='fire')||(ab==='Torrent'&&type==='water')||(ab==='Overgrow'&&type==='grass')))r.hit=Math.min(9999,Math.round(r.hit*1.30));
 return r;
};
const v30OriginalHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
 const defender=who==='enemy'?foe():current(),attacker=who==='enemy'?current():foe();
 if(!battle?.active||!defender||!attacker)return;
 if(type==='ground'&&v30Ability(defender.id)==='Levitate'){
  this.damageLabels.push({x:who==='enemy'?this.enemy.x:this.player.x,y:(who==='enemy'?this.enemy.y:this.player.y)-this.h*.20,text:'LEVITATE · IMUNE',life:.95,color:'#c1edff'});return;
 }
 const hp=defender.hp;
 const r=v30OriginalHit.call(this,who,type,power);
 if(battle?.active&&defender.hp<hp){
  if(v30Ability(defender.id)==='Static'&&Math.random()<.17){const effectSide=who==='enemy'?'ally':'enemy';const st=sideState(effectSide);st.paralyze=1;}
  if(who==='enemy')v30AdvanceMission('damage',Math.max(1,hp-defender.hp));
 }
 return r;
};

// Evolução após combate: tela informativa não modal, não interrompe a progressão.
let v30EvolutionQueue=[];
const v30OriginalXP=awardXP;
awardXP=function(m,amount){const prev=m.id;const events=v30OriginalXP(m,amount);if(m.id!==prev){v30EvolutionQueue.push({from:prev,to:m.id,level:m.level});}return events;};
const v30OriginalResult=resultScreen;
resultScreen=function(title,description,win,canCatch){
 v30OriginalResult(title,description,win,canCatch);
 if(!v30EvolutionQueue.length)return;
 const root=$('modal');if(!root){v30EvolutionQueue=[];return;}
 const holder=document.createElement('div');holder.className='v30Evolution';
 for(const e of v30EvolutionQueue.splice(0,5)){const row=document.createElement('div');row.innerHTML='✨ '+img(e.from)+' <strong>'+D[e.from].name+' → '+D[e.to].name+'</strong> '+img(e.to)+' <small>Nv.'+e.level+'</small>';holder.append(row);}
 root.append(holder);
};

// Rivais e Team Rocket espalhados pelos 13 confrontos do último ginásio.
const v30OriginalLaunch=launchTrainer;
launchTrainer=function(){
 if(save.gym>=8)return v30OriginalLaunch();
 const st=save.stage;if(st===8||st===11){if(!requireTeam()){showItems();return;}
  const g=save.gym,p=GYMS[g],rocket=st===11,ids=rocket?[V27_ROCKET[(g+5)%V27_ROCKET.length],V27_ROCKET[(g+9)%V27_ROCKET.length]]:[V27_RIVALS[g%V27_RIVALS.length],133];
  const queue=ids.map((id,i)=>mon(id,Math.min(p.max-1,p.min+2+Math.floor(st*.65)+i)));
  startBattle(queue,rocket?'🚀 MISSÃO ROCKET · CHEFE':'⚔️ RIVAL BLUE · REVANCHE',false);return;
 }
 return v30OriginalLaunch();
};

// Três objetivos permanentes por jornada (não dependem de servidor externo).
const V30_MISSIONS=[{id:'victories',title:'Vença 12 treinadores',target:12,unit:'victory',coins:60},{id:'damage',title:'Cause 350 pontos de dano',target:350,unit:'damage',coins:85},{id:'capture',title:'Capture 3 Pokémon',target:3,unit:'capture',coins:70}];
let v30MissionState={};try{v30MissionState=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V30_MISSIONS_KEY)||'{}')||{};}catch{}
function v30SaveMissions(){try{localStorage.setItem(V30_MISSIONS_KEY,JSON.stringify(v30MissionState));}catch{}}
function v30AdvanceMission(unit,amount=1){for(const m of V30_MISSIONS){if(m.unit!==unit)continue;
 const st=v30MissionState[m.id]||(v30MissionState[m.id]={n:0,claimed:false});if(st.claimed)continue;st.n=Math.min(m.target,(st.n||0)+amount);
 if(st.n>=m.target){st.claimed=true;save.coins+=m.coins;persist();const l=$('battleLog');if(l)l.textContent='🎁 Missão concluída: '+m.title+' · +'+m.coins+' moedas!';}
 }v30SaveMissions();}
const v30OriginalFinish=finishBattle;
finishBattle=function(win){if(!battle?.active)return;
 const boss=battle.v30Boss,rocket=/ROCKET/.test(battle.label||''),rival=/RIVAL/.test(battle.label||''),wild=battle.wild;
 const completed=win;
 const result=v30OriginalFinish(win);
 if(completed){if(!wild)v30AdvanceMission('victory',1);if(rocket||rival){save.coins+=rocket?18:12;persist();}}
 return result;
};
const v30OldCaught=save.caught?save.caught.length:0;
const v30OriginalPersist=persist;
persist=function(){
 // 3 backups circulares, verificação mínima antes de substituir o último backup.
 try{if(save.starter&&save.team?.length){let a=[];try{a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V30_SAFE_SAVE)||'[]')||[];}catch{}
  const ss={ts:Date.now(),gym:save.gym,stage:save.stage,team:save.team.length,state:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(save))};
  if(!a.length||a[0].gym!==ss.gym||a[0].stage!==ss.stage||ss.ts-a[0].ts>60000){a.unshift(ss);a=a.slice(0,3);localStorage.setItem(V30_SAFE_SAVE,JSON.stringify(a));}
  if(save.caught?.length>v30LastCaught){v30AdvanceMission('capture',save.caught.length-v30LastCaught);v30LastCaught=save.caught.length;}
 }}catch(e){console.warn('Backup V30 não disponível:',e)}
 return v30OriginalPersist();
};
let v30LastCaught=v30OldCaught;
function v30ShowMissions(){const node=document.createElement('div');node.className='v30Missions';node.innerHTML='<strong>🎯 Missões de treinador</strong>'+V30_MISSIONS.map(m=>{const s=v30MissionState[m.id]||{n:0,claimed:false};return '<div class="v30MissionRow"><span>'+m.title+'</span><b>'+(s.claimed?'✓ +'+m.coins+' 🪙':Math.floor(s.n||0)+'/'+m.target)+'</b></div>';}).join('');return node;}
const v30OriginalRender=render;
render=function(){v30OriginalRender();
 if(battle?.active)return;
 const bar=$('resources');if(bar&&!$('v30VersionTag')){const tag=document.createElement('span');tag.id='v30VersionTag';tag.className='v30VersionTag';tag.textContent='V30 · 2D';bar.appendChild(tag);}
 const place=document.querySelector('#main .gymHero')||document.querySelector('#main .v29Endgame');
 if(place&&!document.querySelector('.v30Missions'))place.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',v30ShowMissions());
 const gear=$('v281SettingsButton');if(gear&&!gear.dataset.v30){gear.dataset.v30='1';const old=gear.onclick;gear.onclick=()=>{old?.();
 const area=document.querySelector('.v281SettingsActions');if(!area||$('v30Recovery'))return;const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn ghost';b.id='v30Recovery';b.textContent='🛟 Recuperar salvamento seguro';area.append(b);
 b.onclick=()=>{try{const snapshots=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V30_SAFE_SAVE)||'[]');const item=snapshots.find(x=>x?.state?.team?.length&&x.state.gym>=0&&x.state.gym<=13);if(!item){alert('Nenhum salvamento seguro encontrado.');return;}
 if(!confirm('Restaurar progresso de '+new Date(item.ts).toLocaleString('pt-BR')+'?'))return;
 save={...defaultSave(),...item.state};save.team=save.team.filter(m=>D[m.id]&&m.level>=1).slice(0,6);save.box=(save.box||[]).filter(m=>D[m.id]).slice(0,100);if(!save.team.length)throw Error('invalido');persist();close();render();
 }catch(e){alert('Backup indisponível ou inválido neste navegador.')}};};}
};

// IA ajusta a frequência e as esquivas progressivamente, sem escalar o HP artificialmente.
const v30AIOriginal=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){const old=v30AIOriginal.call(this,dt,now);if(!battle?.active||battle.wild)return old;
 const g=save.gym,step=save.stage,difficulty=Math.min(1,g/10+(step/16));
 if(sideState('enemy').paralyze&&this.enemyAttackCD<.8)this.enemyAttackCD=.8;
 if(this.enemyAttackCD>1.65){this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(1.25,this.enemyAttackCD-dt*.22*difficulty);}
 if(difficulty>.5&&this.foeDodgeCD>2.6)this.foeDodgeCD=2.6;
 return old;
};

// Câmera 2D e redução de falhas em FPS baixo; nenhum sprite aumenta de escala na luta.
const v30CameraOld=v27Cinematic;
v27Cinematic=function(ref){if(!ref?.canvas||!battle?.active)return;
 const mobile=window.matchMedia?.('(max-width:650px)').matches,reduced=window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
 if(reduced||ref.fps<26)return;
 const x=mobile?.35:.65;
 ref.canvas.animate?.([{transform:'translate(0,0)'},{transform:'translate('+x+'%,.12%)'},{transform:'translate(0,0)'}],{duration:320,easing:'ease-out'});
};
const v30ParticleOld=BattleEngine.prototype.particlesAt;
BattleEngine.prototype.particlesAt=function(x,y,color,count=18,speed=120){
 const d=this.fps>0&&this.fps<36?9:this.fps>0&&this.fps<48?15:27;
 if((this.particles?.length||0)>120)return;
 return v30ParticleOld.call(this,x,y,color,Math.min(count,d),speed);
};
window.PokemonTorreDiagnostics=()=>({version:V30_VERSION,active:!!battle?.active,gym:save.gym,stage:save.stage,monsters:save.team.length,wasm:!!v28Wasm,phaser:!!v27Scene,fps:engine?.fps??null,missions:v30MissionState,backup:!!localStorage.getItem(V30_SAFE_SAVE),bossPhase:battle?.v30Phase||null});
/* POKEMON TORRE V30 END */

/* Pokémon Torre V30.1 — reinício de campanha compatível com Android */
(function(){
 const keys=['pokeTorreKantoV7','pokeTorreKantoV8','pokeTorreKantoV29Backup','pokeTorreKantoV30Safety','pokeTorreKantoV30Missions'];
 const css=document.createElement('style');
 css.textContent='.v301ResetPanel{max-width:560px;margin:auto;padding:5px 2px 8px}.v301ResetPanel h2{margin:4px 0 13px;font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,28px)}.v301ResetPanel p{line-height:1.6;color:#cfdeed;font-size:14px}.v301Warning{border:1px solid #a97750;border-radius:13px;padding:13px 15px;background:#412c2888;color:#ffddbb;margin:12px 0 17px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.v301ResetActions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:17px}.v301ResetActions button{flex:1 1 145px;min-height:44px}.v301ConfirmDelete{background:#903d4f!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #c66d7a!important}.v301ResetError{color:#ffd2d7;font-size:13px;margin-top:9px}';
 document.head.appendChild(css);
 function showReset(){
  if(battle?.active)return;
  overlay('<div class="v301ResetPanel" role="dialog" aria-label="Confirmar reinício da campanha"><div class="overline">CONFIGURAÇÕES · NOVA JORNADA</div><h2>↻ Reiniciar campanha?</h2><p>Seu time, sua caixa, os ginásios, a Pokédex, moedas, missões e recompensas voltarão ao início.</p><div class="v301Warning"><b>Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.</b> Também remove os backups automáticos. Para guardar seu progresso, volte às opções e baixe um backup antes.</div><div class="v301ResetActions"><button class="btn ghost" id="v301CancelReset" type="button">Cancelar</button><button class="btn v301ConfirmDelete" id="v301ConfirmReset" type="button">Sim, começar de novo</button></div><div class="v301ResetError" id="v301ResetError" role="alert"></div></div>');
  $('v301CancelReset').onclick=()=>{close();render()};
  $('v301ConfirmReset').onclick=doReset;
 }
 function doReset(){
  const btn=$('v301ConfirmReset');if(btn)btn.disabled=true;
  const previous=save,clean=defaultSave();
  try{
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(clean));
   const check=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY)||'null');
   if(!check||check.starter!==null||!Array.isArray(check.team)||check.team.length)throw Error('Gravação do novo início não confirmada.');
   for(const key of keys)localStorage.removeItem(key);
   save=clean;
   if(typeof v30MissionState!=='undefined')v30MissionState={};
   if(typeof v30LastCaught!=='undefined')v30LastCaught=0;
   stopTimers();battle=null;cooldowns=[0,0,0,0];
   if($('modal'))$('modal').classList.remove('combatModal');
   close();render();
   const banner=document.createElement('div');banner.id='v301ResetSuccess';banner.className='notice';
   banner.textContent='✅ Campanha reiniciada! Escolha seu Pokémon inicial.';
   $('main')?.prepend(banner);
  }catch(err){
   save=previous;if(btn)btn.disabled=false;
   const el=$('v301ResetError');if(el)el.textContent='Não foi possível salvar uma nova campanha. Libere armazenamento e tente novamente. '+String(err?.message||err);
   console.error('Falha ao reiniciar campanha:',err);
  }
 }
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const target=e.target?.closest?.('#v281Restart, #newBtn');
  if(!target||!target.isConnected)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();showReset();
 },true);
})();
/* POKEMON TORRE V30.1 — shiny na caca, 10s teleguiado, animacao de desmaio e reacao dos lideres */
(function () {
  const V301_SHINY_MIN = 0.01, V301_SHINY_MAX = 0.03, V301_HOMING_COOLDOWN = 10000;
  for (const move of Object.values(V30_MOVE_TRAITS)) {
    if (move && move.kind === 'homing') move.cd = V301_HOMING_COOLDOWN;
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(save.shinyCaught)) save.shinyCaught = [];
  const css = document.createElement('style');
  css.id = 'v301FeatureCSS';
  css.textContent = `
    .v301ShinyFlag{display:inline-block;color:#ffdc70;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;line-height:1.4;margin-left:4px;text-shadow:0 1px 4px #0009}
    .v301ShinyCard{border-color:#dfba5a!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #dfba5a33}
    .v301ShinyCard .sprite{filter:hue-rotate(95deg) saturate(1.7) brightness(1.1)}
    .v301ShinyCard .placeholder{display:none!important}
    .v301FaintLabel{position:absolute;z-index:15;left:50%;top:37%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #f0d3bb77;border-radius:10px;color:#f7ece4;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;background:#13202cd9;pointer-events:none;animation:v301FadeOut .7s ease-in forwards}
    .v301LeaderQuote{background:#1c3345;color:#f9e4ad;border:1px solid #806947;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:13px;margin:12px auto;max-width:560px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
    @keyframes v301FadeOut{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-40%)}20%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-80%)}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v301FaintLabel{animation:none}}
  `;
  document.head.appendChild(css);
  const startPrevious = startBattle;
  startBattle = function(enemies, label, wild) {
    if (wild && enemies && enemies[0] && !enemies[0].shiny) {
      const rate = V301_SHINY_MIN + Math.random() * (V301_SHINY_MAX - V301_SHINY_MIN);
      enemies[0].shiny = Math.random() < rate;
      enemies[0].shinyRoll = rate;
    }
    return startPrevious(enemies, label, wild);
  };
  const persistPrevious = persist;
  persist = function() {
    const list = new Set(Array.isArray(save.shinyCaught) ? save.shinyCaught : []);
    for (const m of [...(save.team||[]), ...(save.box||[])]) if(m?.shiny && D[m.id]) list.add(m.id);
    save.shinyCaught = [...list].filter(id=>Number.isInteger(id) && id>=1 && id<=151);
    return persistPrevious();
  };
  const thumbPrevious=thumb;
  thumb = function(m) {
    const html=thumbPrevious(m);
    if (!m?.shiny) return html;
    return html.replace('class="moncard"', 'class="moncard v301ShinyCard"')
      .replace('</strong>', '</strong><span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');
  };
  const pokedexPrevious=showPokedex;
  showPokedex=function(){
    pokedexPrevious();
    const shiny = new Set(save.shinyCaught||[]);
    document.querySelectorAll('.dexGrid .dexCard').forEach((card,index)=>{
      if(!shiny.has(index+1))return;
      card.classList.add('v301ShinyCard');
      const label=document.createElement('small');label.className='v301ShinyFlag';label.textContent='✦ SHINY CAPTURADO';card.appendChild(label);
    });
    const head=$('modal')?.querySelector('.sectionhead');
    if(head){const label=document.createElement('span');label.className='pill';label.textContent='✨ '+shiny.size+' Shiny';head.appendChild(label);}
  };
  const teamPrevious=showTeam;
  showTeam=function(){
    teamPrevious();
    const all=[...(save.team||[]),...(save.box||[])];
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-team]').forEach(button=>{
      const m=all[Number(button.dataset.team)];
      if(!m?.shiny)return;
      button.classList.add('v301ShinyCard');
      const flag=document.createElement('span');flag.className='v301ShinyFlag';flag.textContent='✦ SHINY';button.appendChild(flag);
    });
  };
  const battleRenderPrevious=renderBattle;
  renderBattle=function(){
    battleRenderPrevious();
    if(!battle?.active)return;
    if(battle.foe?.shiny){const n=$('enemyTitle');if(n&&!n.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag'))n.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
    if(current()?.shiny){const n=$('allyTitle');if(n&&!n.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag'))n.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
  };
  const monDrawPrevious=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
  BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(entity,id,isEnemy,now){
    const monster=isEnemy?battle?.foe:(battle?.active?current():null);
    const ctx=this.ctx,shiny=monster?.shiny && monster.id===id;
    const faint=this.v301Faint && this.v301Faint.side === (isEnemy?'enemy':'ally') ? this.v301Faint : null;
    if(!shiny&&!faint)return monDrawPrevious.call(this,entity,id,isEnemy,now);
    ctx.save();
    if(shiny){
      // V35.43: cores shiny mais naturais sem apagar a animação.
      ctx.filter=id===18?'sepia(.25) saturate(1.35) hue-rotate(-12deg) brightness(1.08)':
        id===105?'sepia(.19) saturate(1.25) hue-rotate(-25deg) brightness(1.06)':
        'hue-rotate(38deg) saturate(1.20) brightness(1.06)';
    }
    if(faint){const t=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(performance.now()-faint.start)/faint.duration));ctx.globalAlpha=1-t;ctx.translate(0,t*t*30);}
    try{return monDrawPrevious.call(this,entity,id,isEnemy,now);}
    finally{ctx.restore();}
  };
  function faint(side, done) {
    if(!battle?.active || !engine || battle.v301Fainting)return done();
    const b=battle;
    b.v301Fainting=true;
    b.paused=true;
    engine.v301Faint={side,start:performance.now(),duration:700};
    const arena=$('arenaPro');
    if(arena){const label=document.createElement('div');label.className='v301FaintLabel';label.textContent=(side==='enemy'?D[b.foe.id]?.name:D[current()?.id]?.name || 'Pokémon')+' desmaiou!';arena.appendChild(label);}
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(battle!==b || !b.active)return;
      if(engine)engine.v301Faint=null;
      b.v301Fainting=false;
      b.paused=false;
      done();
    },730);
  }
  const LEADER_LINES=[
    'Brock: Você venceu com determinação. Essa Insígnia é merecida.',
    'Misty: Uau, você superou minha equipe! Preciso treinar ainda mais.',
    'Lt. Surge: Essa me pegou de surpresa! Você lutou muito bem, soldado.',
    'Erika: Que batalha encantadora. Aceito minha derrota com respeito.',
    'Koga: Sua estratégia atravessou minhas ilusões. Meus parabéns.',
    'Sabrina: Não previ tamanho talento. Você conquistou essa vitória.',
    'Blaine: Hahaha! Minhas chamas não foram suficientes desta vez.',
    'Giovanni: Impressionante. Sua força está acima do que eu esperava.'
  ];
  const finishPrevious=finishBattle;
  finishBattle=function(win){
    if(!battle?.active)return;
    const b=battle;
    const leader=win && !b.wild && save.gym>=0 && save.gym<8 &&
      save.stage===v29TrainerCount(save.gym) && /LÍDER/.test(b.label||'');
    const leaderIndex=leader?save.gym:-1;
    const complete=()=>{
      if(!b.active)return;
      finishPrevious(win);
      if(leaderIndex>=0){const modal=$('modal');if(modal){const quote=document.createElement('div');quote.className='v301LeaderQuote';quote.setAttribute('aria-label','Reação do líder derrotado');quote.textContent='💬 '+LEADER_LINES[leaderIndex];const btn=$('nextStage');if(btn)btn.before(quote);else modal.appendChild(quote);}}
    };
    if(b.v301SkipFaint){b.v301SkipFaint=false;complete();return;}
    if(win || current()?.hp<=0){faint(win?'enemy':'ally',complete);return;}
    complete();
  };
  const nextPrevious=nextFoe;
  nextFoe=function(){
    if(!battle?.active || battle.v301Fainting)return;
    const b=battle;
    const last=b.enemies.length===0;
    faint('enemy',()=>{
      if(last)b.v301SkipFaint=true;
      nextPrevious();
    });
  };
  window.PokemonTorre301Diagnostics=()=>({
    shinyCaught:[...(save.shinyCaught||[])],currentShiny:!!battle?.foe?.shiny,
    homingCooldowns:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(V30_MOVE_TRAITS).filter(([,m])=>m.kind==='homing').map(([id,m])=>[id,m.cd])),
    isFainting:!!battle?.v301Fainting,resetAvailable:!!document.querySelector('#v281SettingsButton')
  });
})();

// 1: movesets com recuperacao, ilusoes, Earthquake, Thunder e recuperacao do Hyper Beam.
const skillPrev=skillSet;
skillSet=function(m){const skills=skillPrev(m),custom=V31_SIG[m?.id];if(custom)skills[2]={...custom,cat:custom.power?'special':'status'};
 if(m && V31_SUPPORT.has(m.id) && m.id!==132)skills[3]={name:'Double Team',type:'normal',cat:'status',kind:'illusion',power:0,cost:24,cd:8600,icon:'✨'};
 // Golpes teleguiados nunca recarregam antes de dez segundos.

const movePrev=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){const m=battle?.active?current():null,s=m?skillSet(m)[i]:null;
 if(!s||!battle?.active||battle.paused)return movePrev.call(this,i);
 const now=performance.now();if((cooldowns[i]||0)>now||battle.energy<s.cost||m.hp<=0)return;
 if(this.v31RecoverUntil && now<this.v31RecoverUntil){log('Hyper Beam: recuperando energia!');return;}
 if(s.kind==='recover'||s.kind==='illusion'){
  battle.energy-=s.cost;cooldowns[i]=now+s.cd;
  if(s.kind==='recover'){const gained=Math.max(1,Math.round(m.maxHp*.32));m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+gained);this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y,'#88f3b6',19,90);log(D[m.id].name+' recuperou '+gained+' PV!');}
  else{this.player.inv=Math.max(this.player.inv,1.05);this.player.dodgeCd=0;this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y,'#b6e8ff',17,110);log(D[m.id].name+' criou cópias ilusórias!');}
  persist();return;
 }
 const res=movePrev.call(this,i);
 if((cooldowns[i]||0)>now && s.name==='Hyper Beam')this.v31RecoverUntil=now+1500;
 if((cooldowns[i]||0)>now){this.v31LastUsed=s;const count=this.v31Repeat?.id===m.id&&this.v31Repeat?.slot===i?(this.v31Repeat.count||0)+1:1;this.v31Repeat={id:m.id,slot:i,count,at:now};
  if(s.kind==='area'||s.name==='Thunder'){this.v31Flash={color:TYPE_COLOR[s.type]||'#ffdacc',time:performance.now(),length:240};}
 }

const drawPrev=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;

 const f=this.v31Flash;if(f&&now-f.time<f.length){const ctx=this.ctx;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,1-(now-f.time)/f.length)*.18;ctx.fillStyle=f.color;ctx.fillRect(0,0,this.w,this.h);ctx.restore();}

// 3: lider em posicao discreta atras do adversario; reaproveita imagens ja usadas no jogo.
const renderBattlePrev=renderBattle;

 if(!battle.wild&&save.gym<8){const label=GYMS[save.gym].leader;const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='v31Trainer';box.id='v31Trainer';

 }

// 4: sprites Shiny com paleta por especie. Fallback generico apenas sem sprite disponivel.
const monDrawPrev=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(entity,id,isEnemy,now){
 // V35.43: não substituir Idle/Walk/Attack/Hurt por uma imagem shiny estática.
 // A paleta é aplicada nas mesmas animações do Pokémon normal, conservando
 // caminhada, ataque, dano e desmaio em todas as direções.
 return monDrawPrev.call(this,entity,id,isEnemy,now);

// 5: encontros de dupla assistidos. Os Pokemon secundários têm PV individuais e atacam em paralelo.
const startPrev=startBattle;
startBattle=function(enemies,label,wild){startPrev(enemies,label,wild);if(!battle?.active)return;
 const duo=!wild&&/ROCKET|RIVAL/.test(label||'') && save.team.filter(m=>m.hp>0).length>=2 && battle.enemies?.length>=1;
 if(duo){const idx=save.team.findIndex((m,i)=>i!==battle.pIndex&&m.hp>0);const enemy=battle.enemies.shift();battle.v31Duo={ally:save.team[idx],enemy,clockAlly:1.6,clockEnemy:2.7};
  engine?.loadArt(enemy.id);engine?.loadArt(battle.v31Duo.ally.id);const div=document.createElement('div');div.className='v31DuoChip';div.id='v31DuoChip';div.textContent='⚔️ DUPLA · '+D[battle.v31Duo.ally.id].name+' × '+D[enemy.id].name; $('arenaPro')?.append(div);
 }

};
const updatePrev=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){const beforeX=this.player.x,beforeY=this.player.y;const result=updatePrev.call(this,dt,now);if(!battle?.active||battle.paused)return result;
 if(current()?.held==='quick'){this.player.x+=(this.player.x-beforeX)*.14;this.player.y+=(this.player.y-beforeY)*.14;this.collideRocks(this.player);}
 if(this.v31RecoverUntil && performance.now()<this.v31RecoverUntil){this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(this.enemyAttackCD,.25);}
 const d=battle.v31Duo;
 if(d){d.clockAlly-=dt;d.clockEnemy-=dt;
  if(d.ally.hp>0&&d.clockAlly<=0){d.clockAlly=2.4;let t=d.enemy?.hp>0?d.enemy:foe();if(t&&t.hp>0){const hit=damage(d.ally,t,D[d.ally.id].type,25).hit;t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-hit);this.damageLabels.push({x:this.enemy.x+this.h*.10,y:this.enemy.y-this.h*.16,text:'APOIO -'+hit,life:.8,color:'#b3fff1'});this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x+this.h*.1,this.enemy.y,D[d.ally.id].type==='fire'?'#ffb58e':'#86dfff',10,80);}}
  if(d.enemy?.hp>0&&d.clockEnemy<=0){d.clockEnemy=3.0;const target=d.ally.hp>0?d.ally:current();const hit=damage(d.enemy,target,D[d.enemy.id].type,19).hit;target.hp=Math.max(0,target.hp-hit);if(target===d.ally&&target.hp<=0)battle.v31NoKo=false;this.damageLabels.push({x:this.player.x-this.h*.12,y:this.player.y-this.h*.18,text:'DUPLA -'+hit,life:.8,color:'#ffd5b9'});}
 }
 if(battle.v31Boss&&this.v31Repeat?.count>=3){this.foeDodgeCD=Math.min(this.foeDodgeCD,.9);this.enemyAttackCD=Math.min(this.enemyAttackCD,1.95);}
 // V35.43: não redefina o tempo de ataque a cada quadro. Isso impedia inimigos no Casual de atacar.
 const tier=save.v31Difficulty||'normal';
 if(tier==='mestre'&&this.enemyAttackCD>2.05)this.enemyAttackCD=2.05;
 if(this.v31LeftoverTimer===undefined)this.v31LeftoverTimer=0;
 this.v31LeftoverTimer+=dt;if(this.v31LeftoverTimer>=4){this.v31LeftoverTimer=0;for(const p of save.team){if(p.hp>0&&p.held==='leftovers')p.hp=Math.min(p.maxHp,p.hp+Math.max(1,Math.round(p.maxHp*.035)));}}
 return result;
};
const drawDuoPrev=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){drawDuoPrev.call(this,now);const d=battle?.v31Duo;if(!battle?.active||!d)return;
 const ctx=this.ctx,positions=[{m:d.ally,x:this.player.x-this.h*.19,y:this.player.y+this.h*.12},{m:d.enemy,x:this.enemy.x+this.h*.19,y:this.enemy.y+this.h*.12}];
 for(const pos of positions){const {m,x,y}=pos;if(!m||m.hp<=0)continue;const entry=this.assets?.get(m.id);const pic=m.shiny?v31Img(m.id):entry?.customStatic||entry?.art;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.85;
  if(pic?.complete&&pic.naturalWidth){const width=this.h*.087;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;ctx.drawImage(pic,x-width/2,y-width*.65,width,width);}
  else{ctx.font='12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText(D[m.id].name,x,y);}
  ctx.fillStyle='#12222d';ctx.fillRect(x-19,y+12,38,4);ctx.fillStyle='#83ddbc';ctx.fillRect(x-19,y+12,38*Math.max(0,m.hp/m.maxHp),4);ctx.restore();

function v32Ensure(){
 if(!save.v32||typeof save.v32!=='object') save.v32={};
 const c=save.v32;
 if(!Array.isArray(c.tms))c.tms=[];
 if(!c.tower||typeof c.tower!=='object')c.tower={floor:1,best:0,wins:0};
 c.tower.floor=Math.max(1,Math.min(999,Math.floor(Number(c.tower.floor)||1)));
 c.tower.best=Math.max(0,Math.min(999,Math.floor(Number(c.tower.best)||0)));
 if(!c.league||typeof c.league!=='object')c.league={stage:0,wins:0,championships:0};
 if(!Number.isFinite(c.volume))c.volume=35;
 c.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,c.volume));
 for(const m of [...(save.team||[]),...(save.box||[])]){
  if(!m||!D[m.id])continue;
  if(!V32_NATURES.some(n=>n.id===m.v32Nature))m.v32Nature=V32_NATURES[(m.id+m.level)%V32_NATURES.length].id;
  if(!Array.isArray(m.v32Slots)||m.v32Slots.length!==4)m.v32Slots=null;
 }
 return c;
}
v32Ensure();
